description:
# Hiring: Etsy & Shopify E-Commerce Growth Strategist



**Company:** Bathe In Couture  

**Job Type:** Part-Time | Remote  

**Hours:** 6–10 hours per week initially  

**Compensation:** Based on experience  

**Opportunity:** Long-term position with potential for increased hours based on performance



## About Us



Bathe In Couture is a growing U.S.-based beauty and body care brand specializing in body mists, nourishing body oils, and shower steamers.



Our mission is simple: **Make everyday smell good.**



We currently sell through Shopify, Etsy, and TikTok Shop and are looking for an experienced, results-driven Etsy & Shopify Strategist to help us increase visibility, improve conversions, and generate consistent sales.



We are not looking for someone who simply uploads products or completes administrative tasks. We need someone who understands e-commerce growth and knows how to turn an online store into a profitable business.



## Key Responsibilities



**Etsy Growth & Optimization**

- Audit our existing Etsy shop and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Optimize product titles, descriptions, tags, categories, and attributes using Etsy SEO best practices.

- Research high-performing competitors, keywords, and product trends.

- Develop strategies to improve Etsy search visibility and organic traffic.

- Manage and optimize Etsy Ads with a focus on profitability.

- Recommend pricing, bundles, promotions, and seasonal sales opportunities.

- Analyze Etsy performance and identify why listings are or are not converting.



**Shopify Growth & Conversion Optimization**

- Conduct a comprehensive Shopify store audit.

- Identify opportunities to improve website conversion rates.

- Optimize product pages, collections, product descriptions, and SEO.

- Improve the customer shopping experience and purchase journey.

- Recommend effective upselling, cross-selling, and bundling strategies.

- Analyze website traffic, customer behavior, and sales performance.

- Help develop promotional campaigns that drive purchases.

- Work with our existing Klaviyo
 automations to identify opportunities to improve abandoned-cart recovery, customer retention, and repeat purchases.



**Sales Strategy & Growth**

- Develop a practical 30/60/90-day growth strategy.

- Identify opportunities to generate consistent daily and weekly sales.

- Research successful beauty and body care brands and their selling strategies.

- Recommend promotions and campaigns based on data, not guesswork.

- Identify underperforming products and provide actionable solutions.

- Track performance and provide weekly updates on results, priorities, and next steps.



## Qualifications



- Proven experience growing Etsy and Shopify stores.

- Strong understanding of Etsy SEO, Shopify SEO, and conversion rate optimization.

- Experience managing Etsy Ads and analyzing advertising performance.

- Knowledge of Google Analytics, Shopify Analytics, and Etsy Shop Stats.

- Experience with beauty, skincare, cosmetics, fragrance, or similar consumer products is highly preferred.

- Familiarity with Klaviyo is a plus.

- Strong analytical skills and ability to make data-driven recommendations.

- Excellent written English and communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and proactively identify growth opportunities.



## What Success Looks Like



Our goal is to build a profitable e-commerce brand that generates consistent sales rather than relying on occasional promotions.



We want to see:

- Increased qualified traffic to Etsy and Shopify.

- Improved product visibility and search rankings.

- Higher conversion rates.

- Consistent weekly sales growth.

- Improved return on advertising spend.

- Increased average order value.

- A clear, measurable path toward **$3,000+ in monthly revenue**.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Describe your experience growing Etsy and Shopify stores.

2. Share examples of stores you have worked with and measurable results you achieved.

3. What are the first three things you would review if an Etsy shop receives views but very few sales?

4. What strategies would you use to grow a Shopify beauty brand with a limited advertising budget?

5. Are you experienced with Etsy Ads, Shopify Analytics, Google Analytics, and Klaviyo?

6. What is your hourly rate and availability?



**Important:** Please begin your application with the words **"Everyday Smell Good"** so we know you read the full job description.



We are looking for someone who can bring ideas, execute strategies, measure results, and grow with our brand.



If you have proven experience turning Etsy and Shopify stores into consistent revenue-generating businesses, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Experienced HACCP & Food Safety Coordinator
description:
Wholesale Nutrition | Australian Nutrition & Supplement Business



We are a small Australian business blending and packing protein powders and nutritional supplements. We have an established HACCP-certified operation and are looking for an experienced food safety professional to help maintain our system, improve documentation and prepare for annual audits remotely as much as possible. 



You will work directly with the owner and Australian warehouse team.



Your responsibilities



- Maintain HACCP procedures, forms, registers and document version control.

- Obtain any supplier certifications, COAs, product specifications and expiry dates needed. 

- Check production, receiving, cleaning, calibration, maintenance and training records.

- Support allergen management, label reviews, traceability and annual mock recalls.

- Track corrective actions, follow up missing evidence and prepare audit documentation.



What we’re looking for;



- Practical HACCP experience in audit and gathering documenation in the past. 

- Relevant HACCP training and experience supporting external audits.

- Strong document management, attention to detail and English communication.

- Confidence working independently and following up outstanding tasks.

- Food Science/Food Technology qualifications.



Our warehouse team will perform physical checks and sign-offs; your role is to coordinate, review and maintain accurate records and overtime ideally we plan to introduce AI tools (ChatGPT) where possible to automate document preparation and routine administration wherever practical. 



We’ll provide access to these tools and are looking for someone willing and comfortable learning and helping develop these processes as part of the role, while checking that records remain accurate. This will be secondary and not neccessary but we think useful tool in time. 



To apply, please send:



- Your CV and relevant qualifications.

- A brief example of your HACCP and audit preparation experience.

- Your availability, preferred weekly hours and expected pay, including currency.

title: Engineering Lead
description:
Mission

Our customers use Traduality to serve their limited-English members in their own language, reliably and securely. You will own the platform behind our multicultural customer experience products that use real-time speech translation: Fire Lingo Face-to-Face and Fire Lingo Contact Center. You will build new features, keep production healthy, and use AI-assisted (agentic) engineering as your main way of working.



Responsibilities

Work with the CEO and the technical team to decide what gets built, and bring the longer-term technical view.

Design and build features end to end: backend, web, integrations and infrastructure.

Use agentic engineering (e.g. Claude Code) to deliver work: write development plans and task specs, maintain agent instructions and skills, and review all AI-generated changes.

Review every production change, including AI-assisted changes from non-engineers, and set the guardrails (tests, CI, written conventions) that make that review fast and reliable.

Own our AI translation pipeline (speech-to-text, machine translation, LLMs, text-to-speech). Evaluate and switch vendors per language based on quality, latency and cost.

Own the database: schema changes across single-tenant customer databases, migrations and restores.

Set up and maintain cloud infrastructure for new customers, including backups, monitoring and CI.

Be the first responder when production breaks, and communicate outages to customers clearly and honestly.

Mentor and unblock our junior software developer.



Requirements

About 5 years of professional software engineering experience, including owning production systems.

Fluent English. Spanish is a plus.

Proven hands-on agentic coding experience, with examples you can show us.

Cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred) and Linux administration.

SQL databases, preferably PostgreSQL.

Git and code review workflows.

Experience in Go (our main language). TypeScript is a plus.

Comfort being on call for a production system used during customers’ business hours.

Several hours of daily overlap with US Eastern business hours.



Preferred

Experience integrating LLM or AI APIs in production (e.g. OpenAI, DeepL, speech-to-text/text-to-speech providers)

Ansible or other infrastructure-as-code tools

Monitoring with Prometheus/Grafana

Swift/SwiftUI specifically, including App Store releases

title: Remote E-Commerce VA — Research-Heavy Listing Reviewer & Pricer (Part-Time / Asynchronous) Location: 100% Remote / Onlin
description:
Remote E-Commerce VA — Research-Heavy Listing Reviewer & Pricer (Part-Time / Asynchronous)

Location: 100% Remote / Online (Any Time Zone — Company based in EST)



Schedule: Part-Time — No fixed shift hours or set schedules. Work whenever you want, entirely on your own time.



Structure: Weekly Quota Basis



Start Date: ASAP



Pay Rate: $0.20 per completed listing draft (Expect an average of $200/month)



Payout Schedule: Paid monthly via Wise



Weekly Hard Deadline: All assigned listing drafts for your weekly quota must be completed by Sunday, 7:00 PM EST.



About Distress Vintage LLC

At Distress Vintage LLC, we specialize in sourcing and selling unique vintage and rare pre-owned clothing across top online marketplaces. Because vintage clothing varies wildly in rarity, era, and value, this is a research-intensive role.



We are looking for an analytical, detail-oriented Listing Reviewer & Market Researcher who enjoys digging into product details, finding exact market comps, and ensuring every item is perfectly optimized and accurately priced before going live.



Key Responsibilities (Research & Quality Control Workflow)

Deep Pricing & Market Research: Utilize Google Lens, visual search tools, and historical eBay sold comps—along with our custom prompt system—to identify vintage tags, eras, and exact market value.





Title & SEO Optimization: Craft and refine search-optimized, keyword-rich titles in Nifty.AI based on your research findings (identifying brands, style names, eras, and key features).





Category & Feature Verification: Deep-dive into item details to verify and correct categories, sizes, colors, fabric contents, SKUs, and conditions across eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, and Depop.





Final Listing Approval: Cross-check photo ordering, pricing accuracy, condition notes, and item specifics to ensure each draft is 100% market-ready before saving.





Candidate Requirements

Minimum Requirements:

Strong Research Mindset: High curiosity, patience, and attention to detail when looking up obscure items, tags, and comps online.

You will ideally have:

title: Lead Generation and Outbound Sales Specialist (Part-Time, AU SaaS Client)
description:
Imagine a sales role where you get to d
 how things are done.



An Australian SaaS founder is making his first-ever sales hire — and rather than handing you a script to follow, he wants to build the playbook with you, then trust you to run it. You'll work directly with him (no managers, no coordinators, no layers), get proper one-on-one time to learn the product in week one, and have real support while you find your feet. After that, the targeting, the cadence, the process — it's yours to shape.



If you've ever run someone else's outreach and thought "I'd do this differently," this is your chance to actually do it differently — with a founder who's genuinely asking for your ideas.



Why you'll enjoy this role

- Your ideas carry real weight. Targeting, outreach cadence, qualification criteria, CRM workflow — you help design all of it. He sets the goal; the how is yours.

- Even the tools are up for discussion. The CRM is currently Pipedrive, but if you think Go High Level (or something else) works better, he'll honestly consider switching. He's hiring you for your expertise, not just your output.

- You work directly with the founder. One relationship, clear communication, fast decisions.

- You're trusted, not tracked. Success means qualified meetings on his calendar — not hours logged, not screenshots, not activity reports.

- The product is easy to believe in. It's a digital signature and document management platform with a genuine edge: documents are verified on a blockchain ledger, giving absolute proof nothing was ever altered — at a lower price than DocuSign. Prospects actually want to hear about it.

- You won't be thrown in the deep end. Week one is structured onboarding: your own product login and real one-on-one time with the founder, so you can talk about the product with confidence before any outreach begins. And he reviews message content with you before it goes out — so you're never guessing alone.

- There's a clear path forward. If the first three months go well, the role converts to full-time with a bigger scope.



What you'll get from us

- PHP 21,250/month + PHP 750/month benefits

- 13th month pay

- 10 days paid annual leave

- 5 days paid sick leave

- LinkedIn Sales Navigator access — provided for you

- Family-friendly part-time hours: Monday to Thursday, 10:00 am – 3:00 pm AEST (Brisbane) — around 20 hours a week, with afternoons and every Friday free

- A genuine full-time pathway if the first three months go well



What your days will look like

- Finding the right people — identifying and qualifying SME decision-makers (C-suite, directors, owners) in fitness and wellness, cosmetic injectables, and lending/debt collection

- Running LinkedIn outreach — connection requests, sequences, and follow-up messaging

- Writing messages that get replies — drafting and refining based on what the response rates tell you, with the founder reviewing content before it goes out

- Keeping the pipeline tidy — maintaining the CRM: lead records, conversation status, next steps, and flagging leads that have gone cold

- Booking meetings — scheduling 15-minute discovery calls and 30-minute demos into the founder's calendar (he runs the calls; you fill the diary)

- Shaping the system together — in your first two to four weeks, you and the founder will agree what a qualified lead looks like, the outreach cadence, and the CRM workflow

- Quick daily updates — a short summary on Microsoft Teams so he always knows where things stand. No long reports, no micromanagement.



You'll feel right at home here if you…

- Have run real LinkedIn outreach campaigns before — you can comfortably chat about what you sent, what the response rates were, and what you tweaked along the way. (We genuinely love hearing about the experiments that didn't work — that's how we know you've really done this.)

- Enjoy building rather than following — a role with room to figure out what works sounds like fun, not stress

- Like running your own day — planning your time, tracking your progress, and raising things early rather than waiting to be asked

- Write clearly and well in English — your messages are the first impression prospects get, so polished writing matters here

- Keep a tidy CRM — your pipeline tells a story, not just stores data

- Enjoy a relaxed, no-pretence working relationship — the founder is friendly, casual, and direct. He says what he means, appreciates a good sense of humour, and cares about results over formality. If that sounds refreshing, you'll get along great.



Bonus points (nice, but truly not required)

- Go High Level experience

- LinkedIn Sales Navigator experience

- Background in fitness and wellness, cosmetic injectables, or lending and debt collection

- B2B SaaS outreach experience

- Experience positioning a product against a big-name competitor like DocuSign



Don't have the bonuses? Apply anyway. The essentials above are what matter — everything else can be learned.



One thing worth knowing

Because this is a brand-new function, there's no existing process to inherit — you'll be creating it, with the founder's close support in the early weeks. For the right person, that's the best part of the job: your fingerprints on everything, and the freedom to work the way you know works. If "here's the goal — show us what works" sounds like an adventure, we'd love to meet you.



Schedule

Monday to Thursday, 10:00 am – 3:00 pm AEST (Brisbane)

Law Training Centre is an established online legal education provider. We deliver regulated qualifications and professional legal training through Moodle, supported by specialist tutors and operational teams in the UK.

Moodle is central to how our learners access courses, complete assessments and progress through their qualifications. We want to make better use of its functionality to improve administration, the learner experience, progress tracking, reporting, automation and connections with other systems and learning platforms.

About the role

You will identify opportunities to improve how Moodle is configured and used, translate academic, operational and business requirements into practical Moodle solutions, and implement or coordinate improvements involving workflows, reporting, automation, plugins and integrations. You will also diagnose complex Moodle problems and determine when specialist hosting or development support is required.

A major initial priority will be to support the selection of a suitable Moodle hosting partner and manage the technical planning, testing and delivery of the platform migration. Following migration, you will provide continuing technical oversight, improvement and specialist troubleshooting.

What you will do

• Review how Moodle is currently configured and used and identify underused functionality and opportunities for improvement.

• Improve cohorts, groups, enrolments, roles, permissions, completion rules and learner progress tracking.

• Develop useful operational and management reporting, improve data visibility and automate repetitive Moodle processes where appropriate.

• Improve the technical configuration, workflows, controls and reporting for assessments and examinations, and provide technical escalation support where required.

• Diagnose complex Moodle problems and coordinate appropriate resolutions.

• Assess plugins, including appropriate AI-enabled plugins, integrations, APIs, web services and automation opportunities.

• Assess opportunities to integrate Moodle appropriately with other learning platforms and systems.

• Translate internal requirements into Moodle configurations or clear technical briefs, and test and approve technical changes.

• Support the selection of a suitable Moodle hosting partner and plan and coordinate the migration, testing, implementation and post-migration issues.

• Brief and manage hosting providers, developers and other technical suppliers, including assessing recommendations, costs and completed work.

• Maintain appropriate configuration and technical documentation and oversee testing and release processes.

• Understand and monitor backup, restoration, security and recovery arrangements at an oversight and supplier-management level.

What we are looking for

• At least three years of substantial hands-on Moodle administration and technical configuration experience.

• Direct experience of a significant Moodle migration, major upgrade or platform transition.

• Evidence of improving how an organisation uses Moodle.

• Strong working knowledge of cohorts, enrolments, roles, permissions, completion, assessments and reporting.

• Strong Moodle troubleshooting and technical problem diagnosis skills.

• Experience translating non-technical requirements into Moodle configurations or technical specifications.

• Experience working with Moodle hosting providers, developers or technical suppliers.

• Practical experience involving plugins, integrations, APIs, web services, reporting or automation.

• Clear written and spoken English and the ability to work independently with a UK-based team.

Useful additional experience

• Five or more years of substantial relevant Moodle experience.

• Experience supporting regulated education, professional qualifications or examination delivery.

• Hosting procurement, supplier comparison or migration planning.

• Knowledge of hosting environments, databases, scheduled tasks, backups, restoration, security and recovery at an oversight and supplier-management level.

• Staging environments, security reviews, release control and disaster recovery testing.

• Experience assessing AI-enabled Moodle functionality or integrations with other learning platforms.

Working arrangement

• Remote contractor engagement for a contractor based in the Philippines.

• Approximately three days per week initially.

• Monthly contractor fee of ₱35,000 to ₱50,000 for approximately three days per week (pro rata).

• Full-time equivalent of approximately ₱58,000 to ₱83,000 per month.

• The amount of work may expand or reduce depending on migration workload, platform development and continuing technical requirements.

• An initial 90-day self-employed contractor engagement, followed by review.

• At least six hours within the normal UK working day on each working day.

• Some flexibility outside these hours would be useful for planned technical changes, releases or migration activity.

• Availability for planned examination-day technical support would be useful but is not mandatory.

How to apply

Please complete the Philippine application form through the Law Training Centre recruitment webpage (see link below). You will need to upload your CV and answer six questions about your Moodle experience. You may also upload anonymised or redacted examples of your work. Do not share confidential information, personal data, learner records or material that you are not authorised to provide.

The form will ask for your availability, expected monthly contractor fee for approximately three days per week, the days or hours included in that fee, your additional day rate and your proposed full-time monthly contractor fee if the engagement expands. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a structured technical interview.

Selection approach

We will assess applicants on their Moodle administration and technical configuration, evidence of improving Moodle use, troubleshooting and technical judgement, workflows and reporting, migration and upgrade work, supplier management, and practical experience with plugins, integrations, APIs, web services and automation. We are also interested in experience of learner progress tracking, AI-enabled Moodle functionality and integration with other learning platforms. We will place more weight on specific examples than general claims. Shortlisted candidates should expect practical interview scenarios based on genuine, anonymised Moodle issues previously encountered by Law Training Centre. A short paid assessment may be used after interview only if further evidence is genuinely required.

title: CAD Revision Drafter - MEP (Graduate or Return to Work) | Part-Time to Full-Time
description:
Remote, Philippines · Part-time, moving to full-time · Direct hire – no agencies 



This is a CAD drafting role, not a design role. Clients send us their existing Electrical, Hydraulic and Mechanical drawings with markups and redlines. You make the changes in AutoCAD, accurately and quickly, following the drawing standard that's already there. It's steady, varied work updating existing drawings. You won't be designing projects from scratch. 



Who this suits

We’re open to applicants from a range of backgrounds. This role may suit:



- Someone with drafting or technical experience who is returning to work after a break and wants a flexible way back into the workforce without stepping backwards.



- Someone with foundational AutoCAD skills and limited professional drafting experience who wants to develop their skills and build a career in drafting.



You don't need specific as built drawing experience. We'll teach you our drawing standards and CAD skills and give you insights into the construction industry. A team member will check your work and give you feedback in the early weeks. 



Hours, pay and set-up 



Hours: about 16 to 20 hours a week to start. Within those hours you choose when you work, as long as jobs go out on time. Jobs are small (usually 1 to 6 hours each) with about a two-day turnaround. 



Pay: 3 month probation period, a fixed PHP 13,000 a month for part-time hours, paid monthly. 



Full-time: we'll formally review your progress at 3 months. A successful candidate will transition to full time work (approx. 40 hours) for a fixed PHP 25,000 – 28,000 a month, within six months of starting. 



Pay progression: pay is reviewed annually and good work is rewarded. 



Start: by negotiation. 



Arrangement: direct hire only, no agencies please. 



Equipment: your own PC or laptop that runs AutoCAD, AutoCAD software, reliable internet and a power backup. 



About Design Assist Partners 



Design Assist Partners has been in business for over 21 years, working mainly for Australian construction clients. We're a small, close-knit team, and several of our people started part-time and have grown into senior roles. We update and revise existing Electrical, Hydraulic and Mechanical drawings, and put together supporting documents like Operation & Maintenance (O&M) manuals. 



What you'll be doing 



CAD drafting: making marked-up changes to existing drawings for clients in the construction industry. 



O&M manuals: assembling client information in Microsoft Word and a PDF editor. 



As you grow: helping with job quotes and RFIs, keeping a daily job list and monthly timesheet, tracking your hours against the quote and telling us early if a job is running over, building your own checklists so your work goes out error free, and later helping train newer team members. 



We have a structure in place that will give you opportunity to grow in many areas.  



What we're looking for 



Foundation to Medium Level AutoCAD skills and a real wish to grow and learn. 



A detailed person who is careful and patient. 



Good written and verbal English, and comfortable with Word and Excel. 



Someone who manages their own time and speaks up early if something isn't working. 



Someone who wants to grow into more hours and more responsibility with us. 



Why this role 



There's no travel and no commute, and the hours are flexible. You get steady work with a long-established business and a real path to full time and more responsibility. We want people who join us to feel they're moving forward in a rewarding career. 



How to apply (please read this part) 



Applications that skip a step won't be considered. 



Apply, then
 separately: Apply through the OnlineJobs.ph portal first. Then
 
 directly,  put the words Paying Attention followed by your full name in the subject line. 



Resume or CV. 



Provide some of your own drawing samples. Show us your best work. A school project is fine. Please remove any confidential information. 



In your own words, tell us in a few sentences why this role appeals to you and why it suits your situation right now. Please write this yourself, without AI or a template. Share only what you're comfortable with. 



Your availability: are you working, studying, freelancing or available now, and when could you start?

They are seeking a Customer Service & Sales Coordinator to strengthen client relationships, handle repeat orders, and ensure smooth daily operations.

This is a “farmer” role — focused on maintaining relationships, ensuring repeat business, and delivering excellent service — rather than cold calling or outbound sales.

- Gather caller information (name, address, service request, timelines).

Rental start

Before rental end

Pickup scheduling

- Bring initiative and ownership in shaping a new department.

Team Collaboration

Qualifications

- Strong interpersonal skills — confident, warm, and approachable on the phone.

title: Website Development
description:
# Full-Stack Website Developer – Modern, Fast, SEO-Focused, AI-Ready Roofing Websites (Long-Term)



We are an established roofing and solar company based in Vancouver, Canada. I'm looking for an experienced website developer to build a new website and hopefully continue working with us as we expand.



We've been in business since 2008 and have a substantial collection of completed roofing projects, photographs and industry experience.



I'm not looking for a basic template website. I want to invest in building something properly that will remain modern, fast, easy to manage and adaptable as AI technology continues to develop.



**We're moving away from WordPress.** I'm particularly interested in modern technologies such as Next.js, Astro and Sanity CMS, although I'm open to other non-WordPress recommendations if you can explain why they're better for our needs.



I'm not a developer myself, so I'm looking for someone who can recommend the right approach, explain it in straightforward language and help us make good long-term decisions.



## The Bigger Picture



Our first project will be a new website for West Vancouver Roofing & Solar.



However, this is not intended to be a one-website project.



My longer-term goal is to develop additional roofing businesses and websites in different locations.



Each business will have its own branding, domain, local presence, projects and unique content.



I want the first website built on a reusable foundation so that future websites can share the underlying technology and components without having to rebuild everything from scratch.



The websites must still operate as separate brands with their own content, SEO, tracking and appropriate access controls.



## Website Performance



The website needs to be exceptionally fast, especially on mobile devices.



I want clean development, optimized images and videos, minimal unnecessary JavaScript, appropriate caching and excellent Core Web Vitals.



Speed should be considered throughout development, not something we try to fix after the website is finished.



## SEO From the Beginning



SEO is extremely important to us, particularly local SEO.



We want the website structured properly from the start, including:



- Roofing service and material pages

- City and neighbourhood pages

- Completed roofing projects

- Detailed case studies

- Logical internal linking

- Clean URLs and metadata

- Appropriate schema and structured data

- Image optimization

- XML sitemaps, canonical URLs and redirects

- Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools



I don't want hundreds of nearly identical location pages created just to target keywords.



Our location pages should be supported by actual projects, photographs, case studies and useful information relevant to those areas.



I also want the website prepared for how people increasingly find businesses through ChatGPT, Google AI and other AI-powered search tools.



I'm not expecting anyone to guarantee rankings or AI recommendations. I want a technically sound website with useful, original content based on our actual experience.



## Roofing Projects and Case Studies



We have approximately 200 project photos and 20 videos available initially, with more being added regularly.



Our work includes:



- Standing-seam and other metal roofing

- Asphalt shingles

- Cedar roofing and cedar replacement

- Composite and synthetic roofing

- Flat roofing, including TPO and torch-on

- Skylights

- Solar installations

- Complex and unusual roofing projects



I want a structured project library that makes it easy to add and organize completed jobs.



A project could include its location, roof type, manufacturer, materials, colour, existing conditions, challenges, solutions, photographs, videos and customer reviews.



**The important part is that we should only have to enter the project once.**



The website should then automatically connect that project to the appropriate service, material, neighbourhood, gallery and case-study pages.



Our case studies should go beyond displaying photographs. They should explain the original problem, the options considered, why we recommended a particular roofing system, what was installed and the results.



Over time, I want our websites to become valuable resources built around real roofing experience.



## AI-Assisted Website Management



This is one of my most important requirements.



I want AI integrated into the way we manage and improve our websites, not simply used by the developer to write code.



**Our office staff should be able to manage routine website content without knowing how to program.**



For example, an employee should be able to upload photos and basic details from a completed roofing job, then have AI help:



- Draft the project description and case study

- Suggest appropriate photo descriptions

- Prepare SEO titles and descriptions

- Recommend relevant services and neighbourhoods

- Suggest internal links

- Identify missing information

- Prepare the project for review and publishing



We would review and approve AI-generated content before it goes live.



I also want staff to be able to make ordinary changes, such as editing text, replacing photographs and updating information, through a simple dashboard.



There must be a manual editing option as well, so we're not dependent on AI for every change.



I don't expect every advanced AI feature to be completed immediately. However, I want the underlying system designed for these capabilities, and I'd like applicants to explain what can realistically be included in the initial build.



Ideally, the system will support different employee permissions, an approval process and simple training for new staff.



## CallRail, Analytics and Lead Tracking



We want to properly track where our customers come from.



This includes CallRail, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and appropriate tracking for calls, contact forms and quote requests.



We want to understand which leads originate from Google organic search, Google Business Profile, paid advertising, Bing, social media, referrals and other sources.



CallRail Dynamic Number Insertion must be implemented correctly without compromising our business phone numbers or local SEO.



Eventually, I'd like to connect our marketing data to estimates and completed jobs.



The goal is to understand:



**Where the customer found us → which page they visited → whether they called or submitted a form → estimate → sold job**



I'm more interested in measuring actual business results than simply reporting website traffic.



## Lead Generation



The website should be designed to turn visitors into customers.



We need professional, mobile-friendly contact forms, quote request forms, click-to-call buttons and clear calls to action.



Forms must be reliable, properly tracked and protected against spam without making them frustrating for legitimate customers.



## Long-Term Management and Expansion



I'm looking for someone interested in an ongoing working relationship.



After launch, there will be opportunities to improve SEO, develop new features, monitor performance, improve conversions, refine AI workflows and help launch additional roofing websites.



However, I don't want the business to depend on a developer for routine content updates.



The goal is to have a system that is sophisticated behind the scenes but easy for our employees to operate.



## Security, Ownership and Documentation



The website must have appropriate security, backups and a staging environment for testing changes.



Our company must own and control the domains, hosting, source code, content, photographs, CMS, analytics, Search Console, Tag Manager, CallRail and other important accounts.



The project must also be properly documented so another qualified developer can maintain it if necessary.



I don't want to be locked into one developer or an unnecessarily complicated proprietary system.



## Working Hours and Communication



We are located in Vancouver, Canada.



You can work your normal hours in the Philippines, but you must consistently be available between **8:30 a.m. and 10:30 a.m. Vancouver time on working days**.



Outside that window, your schedule can generally be flexible.



Good communication is important. I want someone who can explain recommendations clearly, raise concerns and help solve problems rather than simply waiting for instructions.



## When You Apply



Please put **ROOFING 2027** at the top of your application.



Please answer the following questions:



1. Would you recommend Next.js, Astro or another non-WordPress platform for this project? Why?



2. Which content-management system would you recommend, and how easy would it be for nontechnical office employees to use?



3. How would you build AI-assisted content management so an employee could upload project photos and details and have AI prepare a draft for review?



4. Have you personally built an AI workflow that creates or updates content in a website or CMS? Please explain what you built.



5. How would you make the website extremely fast, especially on mobile?



6. How would you build technical and local SEO into the website from the beginning?



7. How would you organize roofing services, materials, projects, case studies and neighbourhoods so they automatically connect to one another?



8. How would you build the first website so we can efficiently launch additional independently branded roofing websites using the same underlying system?



9. Have you worked with CallRail, GA4 and Google Tag Manager? Please explain your actual hands-on experience.



10. How would you track calls and form submissions back to their marketing sources and eventually connect them to estimates and sold jobs?



11. What would you do differently today to prepare a website for AI-powered search?



12. Please provide three websites or systems you've personally developed, explain exactly what you did and identify which technologies you used. I'd particularly like to see examples involving structured content, modern frameworks or AI integrations.



13. What tools do you use to test website speed, technical SEO and overall quality?



14. What would you include in the initial launch, and what would you recommend developing afterward?



15. What is your hourly rate in USD, and approximately how long would you expect the initial website to take?



16. Are you interested in maintaining and improving the system after launch, including helping us develop additional websites?



17. Please confirm you can consistently overlap with our working hours between 8:30 a.m. and 10:30 a.m. Vancouver time.



I'm not necessarily looking for the cheapest developer. I'm willing to pay more for someone who is genuinely skilled, reliable, communicates well and can demonstrate strong work.



I'm looking for someone who can help guide this project and hopefully work with us for years.



If you think there's a better way to accomplish what I'm describing, I'm interested in hearing your recommendations.



Thanks,



Doug

title: Contractor Network Development VA – Performance-Based

We are looking for a motivated VA to help us develop relationships with home-service contractors in the U.S.



This is a **performance-based opportunity**, not a traditional hourly VA position. It is best suited for someone with experience in sales, appointment setting, prospecting, cold outreach, recruiting, or business development who is comfortable being rewarded based on results.



### What You’ll Do



* Research and identify home-service contractors in assigned markets

* Contact contractors through approved outreach channels

* Introduce contractors to Booked Services Pro

* Help interested contractors complete the signup process

You will receive the BSP process, messaging, training, and tools needed to do the work.



### Compensation



This is a **performance-based role**.



BSP currently provides milestone-based compensation for qualifying contractor development, including payments for:



* Qualified contractor signup

* Contractor activation

* Contractor remaining active

* First qualifying paid project



There is also an opportunity to earn **ongoing recurring compensation from contractors you personally develop**, based on BSP's collected completed-project fees and applicable performance requirements.

* Sales

* Confident communicating with U.S. business owners

* Persistent without being pushy

* Comfortable with performance-based compensation

title: Content Publishing Specialist (WordPress/Sanity)
description:
Position: Content Publishing Specialist

Employment Type: 2 month Gig (to start)

Location: Remote

Working Hours: Minimum 50% overlap with Eastern Time (ET) business hours

Experience Level: Junior to Intermediate (1–3+ years preferred)



- About the Role



We are looking for a highly detail-oriented Content Publishing Specialist to join our digital marketing team.



This is a high-volume, production-focused role responsible for publishing website content accurately, efficiently, and consistently across multiple client websites using WordPress (Elementor) and Sanity CMS.



The ideal candidate has an exceptional eye for detail, understands what makes a webpage look professional, and can follow established publishing processes while applying foundational SEO best practices.



This is not primarily a content writing or SEO strategy position. Your responsibility will be to take prepared content and turn it into polished, properly formatted, SEO-friendly webpages that are ready for visitors and search engines.



Training, publishing guidelines, templates, and checklists will be provided. However, previous experience working with WordPress, Elementor, and/or Sanity CMS is strongly preferred.



- Key Responsibilities



Content Publishing & Page Formatting



Publish a high volume of blog posts, landing pages, and other website content.



Work within WordPress (including Elementor) and Sanity CMS.



Format content to match established website templates and design standards.



Ensure pages are visually appealing, consistent, and professional across desktop and mobile devices.



Properly format headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, buttons, and other page elements.



Add and optimise images, including sizing, alignment, compression, and descriptive alt text.



Identify and correct layout issues, formatting inconsistencies, broken elements, and visual errors.



Ensure published pages accurately reflect the approved content provided.



- Foundational SEO Implementation



Apply basic on-page SEO best practices to every published page, including:



Entering accurate, optimised SEO title tags and meta descriptions.



Correctly formatting H1, H2, H3, and other heading levels.



Adding relevant internal links using appropriate anchor text.



Ensuring external links are correctly placed and functional.



Checking URL slugs and page structure.



Adding image alt text where appropriate.



Applying appropriate categories, tags, and other CMS fields.



Following provided SEO instructions, content briefs, and publishing checklists.



Identifying obvious SEO issues and escalating them to the appropriate team member.



Advanced SEO knowledge is not required. We will provide training on our publishing standards and SEO processes.



Quality Assurance & Workflow Management



Thoroughly review each page before publishing.



Check desktop and mobile layouts for visual consistency.



Verify links, headings, images, spacing, and formatting.



Catch spelling errors, missing content, formatting mistakes, and inconsistencies.



Manage repetitive publishing tasks while maintaining a consistently high standard of quality.



Follow documented workflows and meet daily or weekly publishing targets.



Track progress and communicate any publishing blockers or issues.



Incorporate feedback quickly and avoid repeating previously identified mistakes.



- What We're Looking For / Required Qualifications



Experience publishing and formatting content in a CMS, preferably WordPress with Elementor or Sanity.



Exceptional attention to detail and strong visual judgment.



Ability to recognise when a page looks polished versus when something is misaligned, inconsistent, or poorly formatted.



Familiarity with basic on-page SEO principles, including title tags, meta descriptions, heading hierarchy, and internal linking.



Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage high volumes of repetitive work.



Ability to follow detailed instructions and established procedures consistently.



Comfortable working independently and maintaining productivity without constant supervision.



Strong written English comprehension and communication skills.



Availability to work at least 50% of working hours overlapping with Eastern Time (ET) business hours.



- Preferred Qualifications



Hands-on experience with both WordPress (Elementor) and Sanity CMS.



Experience publishing SEO-focused blog posts and commercial landing pages.



Familiarity with common WordPress SEO plugins such as Yoast SEO or Rank Math.



Basic understanding of HTML and CSS.



Experience using project management tools such as ClickUp, Asana, Trello, or similar.



Experience working with an SEO or digital marketing agency.



- Who Will Succeed in This Role?



This position is particularly well suited to someone who:



Notices the small things. You catch inconsistent spacing, incorrect headings, missing links, and poorly cropped images that others overlook.



Enjoys structured, repetitive work. You are comfortable publishing many pages each week while maintaining accuracy and quality.



Takes pride in presentation. You care about the final appearance of every webpage, even when the task seems routine.



Works efficiently. You can move through a publishing queue quickly without sacrificing quality.



Follows processes. You understand the importance of consistency across multiple websites and client projects.



Learns quickly. You are comfortable learning new CMS platforms, templates, and publishing requirements.



- Training & Support



We provide onboarding and training covering:



Our publishing standards and quality assurance checklists.



WordPress, Elementor, and Sanity workflows specific to our client websites.



Baseline on-page SEO requirements.



Internal linking guidelines and content formatting standards.



Page design consistency and mobile responsiveness.



Production targets, task tracking, and escalation procedures.



While training is provided, candidates should already be comfortable navigating content management systems and publishing website content.



- Performance Expectations



Success will be measured primarily through:



Publishing accuracy: Pages are published correctly with minimal errors or revisions.



Visual quality: Pages are clean, consistent, and professional on desktop and mobile.



SEO compliance: Required metadata, headings, links, and SEO fields are completed accurately.



Productivity: Consistent achievement of publishing volume targets.



Reliability: Tasks are completed on schedule with clear communication and minimal supervision.



The expectation is to deliver both high output and high quality, rather than prioritising speed at the expense of accuracy.



- How to Apply / Please submit:



Your resume, including relevant CMS experience.



A brief description of your experience with WordPress, Elementor, and/or Sanity.



Examples of webpages or blog posts you have personally published or formatted.



Your location, time zone, and availability to overlap with Eastern Time business hours.



What matters most: We are looking for someone who can publish content repeatedly, accurately, and efficiently — and who takes pride in making every page look right, down to the smallest detail.

title: Senior Recruiter

Senior Recruiter

Full-Time | Fully Remote | Philippines-Based | Direct Hire with Client



About the Opportunity

Alderstone Partners is representing a U.S.-focused recruitment firm seeking an experienced Senior Recruiter based in the Philippines to join its team directly and support recruitment activity across California and Colorado.



This is a full-time, direct-hire opportunity with the client organization. The successful candidate will not be employed by Alderstone Partners, and this is not a temporary staffing assignment.



We are looking for a recruiter with hands-on experience supporting the U.S. market and managing the recruitment process from sourcing and outreach through screening, interview coordination, candidate follow-up, and pipeline management.



The strongest fit will be someone who combines sourcing capability with sound candidate judgment, consistent follow-through, and professional communication with both candidates and hiring stakeholders.



What You’ll Do

* Source qualified candidates for U.S.-based positions using LinkedIn, Indeed, job boards, databases, referrals, and other sourcing channels

* Conduct outbound candidate outreach through
, LinkedIn, phone, SMS, and other approved channels

* Screen and qualify candidates against position requirements

* Conduct initial candidate conversations and assess experience, motivation, compensation expectations, availability, and overall alignment

* Manage multiple requisitions and candidate pipelines simultaneously

* Maintain timely and consistent candidate follow-up throughout the recruitment process

* Coordinate interviews and candidate availability

* Communicate with recruiters, hiring managers, and other stakeholders supporting U.S. hiring

* Maintain accurate candidate records, notes, status updates, and recruiting activity within ATS or CRM systems

* Conduct Boolean searches and targeted talent mapping for specialized or difficult-to-fill positions

* Support candidates through interview, offer, and pre-employment stages where applicable

* Maintain a professional and responsive candidate experience

* Deliver consistent recruitment activity and results while maintaining candidate quality



What We’re Looking For

* Professional experience supporting U.S. recruitment

* Experience recruiting for U.S.-based positions, clients, or hiring teams

* Strong candidate sourcing and outreach skills

* Experience screening and qualifying candidates

* Ability to manage multiple searches and priorities independently

* Strong written and spoken English communication

* Comfortable communicating directly with U.S.-based candidates and stakeholders

* Strong organization and attention to detail

* Consistent follow-through and candidate communication

* Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment

* Experience using ATS platforms, job boards, sourcing tools, and other recruitment technology

* Availability to support U.S. business hours based on client requirements

* Healthcare

* Technology / SaaS

* Professional Services

* Financial Services

* Manufacturing

* Logistics / Supply Chain

* Engineering

* Insurance

* Accounting / Finance

* Legal

* MedTech

* Transportation

What We Value

We are especially interested in recruiters who demonstrate:

* Candidate judgment — The ability to determine whether a candidate is genuinely qualified rather than relying only on keyword matches

* Communication — Clear, professional, and timely communication with candidates and stakeholders

* Ownership — The ability to manage searches independently and follow through consistently

* Relationship building — The ability to maintain strong professional relationships with candidates throughout the hiring process

Compensation

PHP 50,000 to PHP 100,000 per month

Final compensation will depend on relevant experience, U.S. market exposure, recruiting specialization, sourcing capability, communication skills, and overall alignment with the client’s requirements.



Employment Structure

This is a direct-hire opportunity with Alderstone Partners’ client.

The selected candidate will join and work directly with the client organization.

title: Real Estate Content & Marketing Virtual Assistant
description:
Freedom Management is seeking a creative, organized, and proactive Virtual Assistant to support Andrew Freed's personal brand and the company's real estate marketing initiatives. This role combines content creation, video editing, social media management, podcast support, event coordination, and property marketing.



About the Role

Andrew Freed is a multifamily real estate investor, real estate agent, podcast host, and community builder. The person in this role will take raw ideas, videos, voice notes, property updates, and podcast content and turn them into polished, on-brand marketing assets. The ideal candidate is comfortable managing several projects at once, working independently, and following through without constant supervision.

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation & Editing

• Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts.

• Create podcast clips, captions, hooks, thumbnails, carousels, quote graphics, educational posts, and other branded assets.

• Repurpose long-form podcasts and videos into multiple platform-specific pieces of short-form content.

• Write social media captions, LinkedIn posts, short video scripts, email copy, and content outlines in Andrew's voice.

• Review all content for spelling, branding, formatting, audio quality, factual accuracy, and overall professionalism.

• Maintain consistent fonts, colors, logos, messaging, and brand standards across all materials.

• Organize raw footage, completed edits, graphics, captions, and approved final assets in clearly labeled folders.

Social Media Management

• Maintain weekly and monthly content calendars and schedule approved content through Buffer.

• Manage posting across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok.

• Help launch, optimize, and manage Andrew's TikTok account.

• Adapt content for each platform rather than publishing the exact same version everywhere.

• Add captions, hashtags, tags, links, thumbnails, and clear calls to action.

• Monitor comments and direct messages and route important inquiries to the appropriate team member.

• Track basic analytics, identify high-performing topics, and recommend new content ideas.

• Confirm scheduled posts publish correctly and promptly resolve formatting, tagging, or link issues.

Podcast Support

• Research potential podcast guests and coordinate outreach, scheduling, reminders, and follow-up.

• Collect guest biographies, headshots, social links, and promotional materials.

• Prepare basic guest briefing documents and suggested interview questions.

• Coordinate with podcast editors and monitor production and publishing deadlines.

• Create episode titles, descriptions, show notes, timestamps, social captions, and promotional clips.

• Send guests completed marketing assets when their episodes are published.

• Maintain an organized podcast guest and production tracker.

Monthly Real Estate Meetup

• Support the planning and promotion of Andrew's monthly real estate meetup.

• Contact and coordinate speakers, panelists, sponsors, vendors, and special guests.

• Collect speaker headshots, biographies, topics, and presentation materials.

• Create event graphics, social posts, email announcements, registration materials, and reminder communications.

• Build and update presentation decks, speaker introductions, agendas, sponsor slides, and run-of-show documents.

• Track registrations, maintain attendee lists, and organize event records.

• Create post-event recaps, photos, short videos, and follow-up content.

• Follow up with speakers, sponsors, and attendees after each event.

Off-Market Property Marketing

• Create professional marketing materials for off-market and listed real estate opportunities.

• Develop property flyers, one-page summaries, social graphics, email campaigns, and presentation decks.

• Organize property photos, rent rolls, financial details, maps, and investment highlights.

• Verify addresses, pricing, rents, contact information, and property details before publication.

• Coordinate with Andrew and the real estate team to obtain missing information.

• Prepare materials for social media, email lists, investor groups, and direct buyer outreach.

• Maintain a tracker of available, upcoming, under-contract, and sold properties.

Project & Team Coordination

• Track assignments, approvals, deadlines, and outstanding items across content, podcast, event, and property-marketing projects.

• Follow up when materials, decisions, or deliverables are late.

• Turn meetings and voice notes into organized tasks and action items.

• Maintain shared folders and ensure files are clearly labeled, current, and easy to locate.

• Proactively identify bottlenecks, quality concerns, and missed opportunities, and recommend practical solutions.

Weekly Reporting

Provide a concise weekly update covering:

• Content published and content currently in production.

• Upcoming podcast episodes and guest-coordination status.

• Monthly meetup progress and outstanding needs.

• Active property-marketing projects.

• Missed deadlines, bottlenecks, and items requiring Andrew's approval.

• Recommended next steps and opportunities for improvement.

Required Qualifications

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Demonstrated experience creating and editing social media content.

• Video editing experience using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Descript, or similar software.

• Strong Canva and presentation-design skills.

• Experience managing Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, or YouTube.

• Familiarity with Buffer or another social media scheduling platform.

• Strong organizational, project-management, and follow-up skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.

• Ability to work independently with limited supervision.

• Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a backup plan for power or connectivity issues.

• Availability for partial overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting a personal brand, entrepreneur, podcast, real estate investor, brokerage, or property-management company.

• Knowledge of multifamily investing, house hacking, cash flow, NOI, cap rates, rent rolls, value-add investing, and syndications.

• Experience creating real estate flyers, offering summaries, or property-marketing packages.

• Experience coordinating podcasts, events, meetups, webinars, or speakers.

• Familiarity with Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, and project-management tools.

• Ability to turn rough ideas and raw materials into polished deliverables with minimal direction.

Ideal Candidate

You are creative but highly organized. You can edit a video, design a graphic, write a caption, coordinate a podcast guest, and keep multiple projects moving at the same time. You take ownership, communicate clearly, follow up consistently, catch mistakes before publication, and suggest improvements instead of waiting for every instruction.

Performance Expectations

• Deliver accurate, polished work by the agreed deadline.

• Respond promptly during scheduled working hours and communicate early when a deadline may be at risk.

• Maintain organized project trackers and shared folders.

• Protect confidential company, investor, tenant, and property information.

• Use sound judgment and obtain approval before publishing sensitive, financial, or property-specific information.

Application Requirements

Please submit the following:

• Resume.

• Links to social media accounts or brands you have supported.

• Two examples of short-form videos you edited.

• Two examples of graphics, carousels, property flyers, or presentations you created.

• A brief explanation of your real estate knowledge and relevant experience.

• Your weekly availability and expected overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

• Your internet speed and backup plan.

• Your desired start date.

Final candidates may be asked to complete a short paid skills assessment.

title: SEO Specialist with Web Development Experience Required
description:
We're Recruiting a SEO Specialist with Web Development Experience Required



Company: Allied Health Media

Job Type: Full-time

Work Setup: Remote

Working Hours: Mon-Sat / 9AM-6PM UK time


 



About Allied Health Media



Allied Health Media (Allied Health Media Limited) is a UK healthcare marketing agency, headquartered in London, founded by Abhay Patel in 2022. It helps private medical consultants grow their practices through AI-driven visibility and patient acquisition — ranking them top-3 on Google Maps and AI search to drive self-pay patient calls. Its core offerings include the 12-month Practice Authority Accelerator program, a website design/build service with ongoing retainer, and the Medical Authority Media Series for video and personal branding, all delivered through an in-house team spanning growth, CS, SEO, production, design, and development.



About the Role



As our SEO Specialist, you'll own the organic search performance of a portfolio of client websites, most of them in healthcare. That means running full technical and on-page audits, catching crawling, indexing, and architecture issues before they hurt rankings, and keeping Core Web Vitals, structured data, and site health in good shape. You'll turn findings into clear, actionable tasks for developers and content teams, then verify the fixes actually landed correctly on the live site — not just take someone's word for it. You'll also track performance through GA4 and Search Console, investigate unusual traffic or ranking shifts, and report on what's working, what isn't, and what should happen next. Because our clients operate in healthcare, you'll need to apply extra care and sound judgement around medical content accuracy, not just chase quick wins.



Do Not Apply If...



You rely solely on automated tool scores instead of professional judgement

You don't follow through to confirm that requested fixes were actually implemented correctly

You're uncomfortable explaining technical SEO issues to non-technical team members

You cut corners on accuracy, especially with medical/healthcare content

You need close supervision to manage multiple client websites and priorities

You're not comfortable learning new SEO tools and platforms.

You don't have a background or practical experience in web development.



Key Responsibilities



Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits, covering crawling, indexing, rendering, and site architecture.

Review and optimise XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, and URL structures.

Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile usability.

Review and troubleshoot structured data and schema markup.

Monitor Google Search Console for indexing, crawling, and performance issues, and investigate unusual changes.

Support website migrations, redesigns, and staging-to-live launches.

Optimise on-page elements — titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal linking.

Identify duplicate, thin, or competing pages and recommend consolidation or redirection.

Review and QA completed SEO and development work across desktop, tablet, and mobile before sign-off.

Retest and verify that requested fixes have been implemented correctly on the live site.

Monitor organic traffic, rankings, and conversions via GA4, and prepare clear performance reports.

Coordinate with developers, designers, and content teams — writing clear, actionable SEO tasks.

Apply extra care, accuracy, and professional judgement when working with healthcare and medical content.



Skills and Tools Required



At least two years of practical SEO experience.

Strong knowledge of technical SEO and on-page optimisation.

Experience conducting detailed website audits and prioritising fixes by impact.

Understanding of crawling, indexing, canonicalisation, redirects, and URL structures.

Experience with structured data/schema markup and Core Web Vitals.

Familiarity with WordPress or a similar CMS, plus basic HTML/CSS.

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

Experience working with developers and verifying completed fixes.

Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical issues simply.

Working knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, and Google Tag Manager.

Experience with SEO platforms such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, or Semrush.

Familiarity with PageSpeed Insights/Lighthouse, Looker Studio, and schema validation tools.



Compensation



We offer a competitive, performance-based package tailored to your experience and track record, with room to grow as you take on more client responsibility. This is a long-term opportunity with a stable, growing agency — not a short-term contract — and we reward accuracy, reliability, and great work with real career progression.



Why Join Us?



Work across a real portfolio of client websites, including meaningful healthcare projects where your work genuinely matters.

Join a fast-growing team where your audits and recommendations directly shape client results.

Flexible, remote-friendly setup with a supportive, collaborative team culture.

Room to grow into more senior SEO or strategy roles as the company scales.

Exposure to a variety of tools, platforms, and industries — never the same day twice.

A team that values professional judgement, accuracy, and follow-through over vanity metrics.





Ready to Join a Fast-Growing Team?

If you take pride in thorough audits, clear recommendations, and following through until it's actually fixed, we'd love to hear from you. Apply below and show us what you can do.

About the Role



Kingsbay Group is seeking a highly analytical, self-driven Walmart Marketplace Operations Specialist to join us. In this role, you will own the day-to-day execution, health, and compliance of our Walmart Marketplace storefront. As an Individual Contributor, you will be the "go-to" subject matter expert for all things Walmart and managing everything from vendor onboarding and account health to inventory coordination and listing optimization.



If you are a marketplace expert who thrives on absolute ownership and loves turning complex catalogue data into smooth, high-performing operations, we want to work with you.



Scope of Work & Deliverables



• Account Health & Compliance Management: Perform daily monitoring of Walmart account health, independently identifying platform risks and executing corrective actions to maintain account integrity.



• Vendor Onboarding & catalogue Management: Manage the end-to-end Walmart onboarding process for new vendors, delivering complete documentation coordination, listing setups, and catalogue activations.



• Listing Content Quality Control: Review and optimize Walmart product listings, variations, images, and content to ensure they consistently align with brand guidelines and platform requirements.



• Analytics & Performance Reporting: Provide regular data-driven analysis on key performance metrics, including sales trends, buy box performance, conversion rates, and fulfilment KPIs.



• Process Optimization & SOP Creation: Identify operational inefficiencies and independently develop, document, and refine standard operating procedures (SOPs) for Walmart marketplace workflows.



• Inventory Insights: Deliver Walmart-specific demand insights and forecasts to assist the Purchasing and Logistics teams in resolving inbound or replenishment friction.



• Cross-Functional Data Sharing: Coordinate autonomously with internal teams (Account Management, Logistics, Marketing, Finance) on an as-needed basis to provide data inputs and clarify platform issues.



• Customer Experience Tracking: Analyse return drivers and product review trends, executing targeted, platform-specific solutions to improve customer satisfaction metrics.







Requirements



• Proven Expertise: Minimum 2–4 years of hands-on experience independently managing Walmart Marketplace / Walmart Seller Centre.



• Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Walmart’s ecosystem, including account health metrics, Buy Box dynamics, repricing strategies, and listing optimization.



• Analytical Capabilities: High proficiency in spreadsheet data analysis and turning raw marketplace KPIs into operational improvements.



• Communication: Fluent in professional written and spoken English for seamless cross-border coordination.

We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)
