title: Healthcare Operations and Revenue Cycle Virtual Assistant
description:
Position Overview

The Healthcare Operations and Revenue Cycle Virtual Assistant will support EVV reconciliation, billing and claim resolution, private-pay accounts receivable, payer enrollment and claims-platform administration, referral intake, eligibility and authorization tracking, documentation quality, scheduling, patient communication, recruitment, credentialing, management reporting, referral outreach, and general administration. This is an administrative position and does not include independent clinical judgment or licensed nursing practice.



Key Responsibilities

• EVV monitoring and reconciliation  Review Alora and Sandata exceptions, identify missing clock-ins or clock-outs, compare scheduled and verified hours, contact caregivers for supported corrections, and prepare daily exception reports.

• Billing, denial resolution, and accounts receivable  Reconcile authorized hours, EVV, service documentation, and claims; prepare claims and post remittances. Investigate denied, rejected, underpaid, and unpaid claims; identify errors involving patient or payer data, provider information, service codes, modifiers, units, dates, authorizations, EVV, documentation, timely filing, or submission format; and correct administrative errors or coordinate corrections with the responsible team member. Contact and follow up with the Ohio Department of Medicaid (ODM), Medicaid managed-care plans, commercial insurers, and other payers; record denial reasons, payer reference numbers, actions, and next follow-up dates; submit corrected claims or prepare reconsiderations and appeals under approved procedures; and verify acceptance, adjudication, and payment through resolution or escalation.

• Private-pay invoice follow-up  Reconcile invoices, statements, and payments; professionally contact private-pay clients or authorized responsible parties regarding delayed or unpaid invoices; resend statements; resolve routine administrative discrepancies; document communications and payment commitments; and escalate disputes, hardship requests, payment arrangements, refunds, write-offs, or high-value balances for approval.

• Payer enrollment and claims-platform administration  Maintain accurate enrollment, linkage, access, and organization records in ODM PNM, Medicaid managed-care and commercial payer portals, clearinghouses, EFT and ERA systems, and claims-submission and remittance platforms. Track applications, corrections, revalidations, renewals, rosters, service locations, NPI and taxonomy data, contacts, W-9 and legal-entity information, and required documents through completion. Verify that Peniel can submit claims, receive remittance information, and receive payment; promptly escalate access, enrollment, linkage, or payment-routing problems.

• Referral intake  Monitor CarePort,
, fax, and other approved referral portals. Collect demographics, insurance information, service needs, and required documents; request missing items; update referral status; and coordinate prompt routing for acceptance review.

• Eligibility and authorization tracking  Verify coverage through approved portals, record verification details, track authorization periods and units, maintain ISP and plan-of-care checklists, and alert management before expirations, shortages, or renewal deadlines.

• Documentation quality assurance  Check records for required fields, dates, signatures, service descriptions, start and stop times, units, and alignment with the ISP or plan of care. Request completion from caregivers and assemble organized audit packets.

• Scheduling administration  Confirm shifts, maintain caregiver availability, notify preapproved caregivers of openings, send reminders, document call-offs, and maintain records of coverage attempts and schedule changes.

• Patient and family communication  Complete introductory and routine status calls, send appointment reminders, conduct approved scripted satisfaction surveys, document nonclinical requests, and route concerns to the appropriate Peniel leader.

• Recruitment and HR administration  Post approved openings, screen candidates against objective criteria, schedule interviews, collect onboarding documents, and track training, background checks, credentials, and expiration dates.

• Credentialing administration  Maintain renewal calendars, compile credentialing applications, update rosters, collect supporting documents, and track submissions and follow-up items through completion.

• Quality and management reporting  Prepare dashboards covering census, referral conversion, uncovered shifts, service utilization, authorization balances, claim denials, payer and private-pay aging, payer-enrollment status, overtime, documentation status, and caregiver retention.

• Marketing and referral outreach  Maintain the referral-source CRM, identify hospitals, county boards, managed-care plans, veterans' organizations, and community partners, prepare non-PHI outreach, schedule meetings, track follow-up, and update approved social-media content.

• General administration  Support inbox management, meeting scheduling, SOP formatting, vendor follow-up, invoice tracking, action lists, and organized electronic records so owners and local leaders can focus on growth, patient care, and oversight.



Required Qualifications

• At least two years of recent experience supporting a U.S. healthcare, home care, home health, medical billing, revenue-cycle, or patient-access organization.

• Hands-on experience with U.S. healthcare billing, denial resolution, corrected-claim submission, payer follow-up, and accounts receivable, including professional follow-up on past-due private-pay invoices.

• Experience maintaining payer enrollments or provider records in Medicaid, managed-care, commercial insurance, clearinghouse, claims, remittance, EFT, or ERA platforms, plus at least two of these areas: EVV management, eligibility verification, prior authorization, referral intake, scheduling, credentialing, recruitment administration, or medical-record quality review.

• Working knowledge of HIPAA, protected health information, secure communication, and minimum-necessary access.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to maintain accurate trackers, aging reports, dashboards, calendars, and CRM records while reconciling information from multiple systems.

• Professional spoken and written English, excellent attention to detail, sound judgment, reliable follow-through, and willingness to escalate rather than guess.

• Ability to work the stated U.S. Eastern Time schedule consistently, including overnight hours in the Philippines.

title: 🐾 WE’RE HIRING: SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT MARKETING MANAGER The Pet Care Club of Seattle | Seattle, WA
description:
We’re not looking for someone to simply “keep our social media active.”



We’re looking for someone who can make people stop scrolling, understand what makes us different, and want their dog to be part of it.



The Pet Care Club of Seattle is an established, locally owned pet care company that has been serving Seattle-area pets and their people for nearly 20 years—and we’re entering one of the most exciting chapters in our history.



We’re changing the way people think about dog walking.



Our new Behavior + Enrichment Membership combines professional dog walking with R+ positive reinforcement, force-free, low-stress, Fear Free–focused methods designed to make a walk more meaningful than simply getting a dog around the block.



We want Seattle pet parents to understand why that matters.



And that’s where you come in.



WHAT WE NEED



We’re looking for a creative, strategic storyteller who gets genuinely excited about taking a great idea and getting others excited about it, too.



Someone who can help us:

• Educate pet parents about R+ positive reinforcement, enrichment, behavior, decompression, confidence building, leash skills, reactivity, and what dogs actually need from their walks

• Turn those sometimes-complex concepts into engaging, easy-to-understand content people actually want to consume

• Show the real-life difference between an ordinary dog walk and an intentional Behavior + Enrichment walk

• Tell stories about the dogs we work with and the progress we see

• Create compelling Reels, short-form video, carousels, graphics, stories, and posts

• Develop hooks and concepts that make people stop scrolling

• Showcase our team, our personality, and the humans behind the business

• Create content for our dog walking, training, puppy, and cat services while keeping our Behavior + Enrichment membership at the heart of our current growth strategy

• Build excitement around The Pet Care Club—not simply awareness

• Help turn followers into inquiries, and inquiries into clients

• Engage authentically with our local community and help grow a recognizable Seattle pet-care brand

• Pay attention to what performs, test new ideas, and continually improve our content strategy



THIS IS IMPORTANT: WE WANT HUMAN-CREATED CONTENT

We believe people are becoming increasingly tired of social media that sounds, looks, and feels AI-generated.



So are we.



We're looking for someone with their own voice, creativity, judgment, humor, curiosity, and ideas.



We don't want someone using generative AI to write our captions, create our posts, manufacture our imagery, or replace original creative work.



We want our content to sound like people talking to people.

Our dogs are real.

Our team is real.

Our clients are real.

Our stories should feel that way too.

YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF…

You understand that good social media isn't just “posting consistently.”

You know how to find the story.



You can look at a video of a dog learning to disengage from another dog and immediately start thinking:



"People need to understand why THIS is a big deal."

You know the difference between educating and lecturing.

You understand how to make content useful and entertaining.

You have strong instincts around hooks, storytelling, pacing, copywriting, video, and calls to action.

You’re comfortable bringing us ideas rather than waiting for us to tell you exactly what to post.

You’re curious enough to learn our approach to dog behavior and enrichment so that you can communicate it accurately.

You care about the details.

And ideally, you’re a little obsessed with dogs. 😉



WE'D ESPECIALLY LOVE SOMEONE WHO HAS:

• Proven experience growing or managing social media for a consumer-facing brand

• Strong short-form video/Reels experience

• Excellent writing and storytelling skills

• Experience with Instagram and
; additional platform expertise is a plus

• A strong visual eye and the ability to create polished content that still feels natural and human

• An understanding of what makes people share, save, comment, click, and inquire

• Experience translating educational topics into compelling consumer content

• An understanding of local/community-based marketing

• The ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and communicate proactively

• Enough confidence to say, “I have an idea…” and run with it



Pet industry experience is wonderful, but marketing talent, curiosity, and the ability to understand our mission matter more.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success isn't simply posting numerous times a week.

We want to see people begin saying:

“I had no idea dog walking could do that.”

“This is exactly what my dog needs.”

“How do I sign up?”



We’ll look at meaningful indicators like engagement, saves, shares, reach within our local market, website traffic, inquiries, membership interest, and ultimately new clients—not vanity metrics alone.



ABOUT US

The Pet Care Club of Seattle is a locally owned, woman-owned company serving Seattle-area pets and their people since 2007.



We believe pet care can—and should—be better.



Our approach centers on relationship, enrichment, positive reinforcement, thoughtful handling, and meeting each animal where they are.



Our growing services include Behavior + Enrichment dog walking memberships, classic and on-demand dog walks, dog training, puppy services, and cat care.



We're building something different, and we're looking for someone who wants to help us tell that story.



INTERESTED?

• A little about yourself and why this particular brand and role interests you

• Examples of social media accounts or content you've created

• Two or three pieces of content you're especially proud of and why

• Any measurable results you're able to share

• Your availability and compensation expectations



And because we care much more about how you think than receiving a perfectly polished cover letter:

We can't wait to see what you come up with. 🐾

You will help the team stay organized and accountable. Project coordinators make scheduling commitments; project managers own field execution and job quality; the Production Manager makes operational decisions. You will make sure missing information reaches the right person promptly.



## You may be a good fit if you



- Have experience supporting construction, roofing, home services, or project management teams.

- Are highly organized and comfortable following up with people repeatedly and professionally.

- Can review dozens of jobs without losing track of details.

- Write clear English and can turn a complicated situation into a short, useful update.

- Are comfortable learning software and following detailed processes.

- Can work independently during U.S. Eastern business hours.



Experience with CompanyCam, Zoho, AccuLynx, or similar construction software is a plus.



## What success looks like



Every active job has a current status and the required photo checklist. Missing updates are followed up the same day. Jobs waiting to be scheduled have a documented next action. Completed jobs move promptly toward invoicing. Our Production Manager receives a short list of exceptions and decisions instead of having to search through every job.



## To apply



Please send your résumé and a short explanation of your construction or project coordination experience. Also answer this question:



**A project manager says a job is complete, but CompanyCam has no final photos and the customer walkthrough is not documented. What would you do next, and what would you include in your update to the Production Manager?**

description:

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Motion Graphics and Effects)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We sell pet products across several brands on Amazon, Chewy, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and through retail partners. We are looking for an inventive, trend-savvy short-form video editor to create scroll-stopping, high-converting video for all of our brands.



You will turn raw phone footage from our in-house team and content creators into organic TikToks and Reels, product videos for Amazon, Chewy, and TikTok Shop, and paid social and Amazon Sponsored Brands video ads.



You won’t just be cutting clips together. You will add creative flair, dynamic masking, kinetic transitions, and sound design to make simple clips feel clever and fun. You should be fluent in TikTok and IG culture, native trend formats, and creative visual editing tricks.



We work AI-first. You should already use AI features in your editing tools (for example, DaVinci Resolve Magic Mask or CapCut auto cutout) to work faster without lowering quality.



Pay: USD 1,500 to 2,000 per month, depending on experience

Schedule: [fill in, e.g. US Pacific Time business hours]

Reports to: Creative Director. You will work day to day with our Social Media Manager and other marketing managers.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Organic Social Video (about 20 hours per week)



Edit 9:16 vertical videos for TikTok and Instagram Reels using raw footage from our in-house social team and content creators.

Apply creative visual effects, including dynamic rotoscoping and masking (sticker peel effects, freeze-frame cutouts, object pop-ins), seamless jump cuts, disappearing and appearing object tricks, match cuts, native collage, paper tear, 2D sticker animations, and seamless loops built for replay value.

Time cuts, transitions, text animations, and effects precisely to the beat of the music.

Design on-screen text with a refined eye: choose and pair fonts, set clear hierarchy and spacing, keep text within platform safe zones, and animate it so it looks polished and premium, not template-based.

Add trending audio licensed for business accounts, sound effects, animated captions, and platform-native text styles.

Bring your own ideas for hooks, pacing, and trend formats instead of only assembling footage.



Marketplace Video (about 10 hours per week)



Create product videos for Amazon (listing and A+ Content), Chewy, and other channels.

Adapt content to each platform’s formats, including 16:9, 1:1, and 9:16.

Follow each retailer’s content guidelines, with clear product benefits and demonstrations.



Paid Ads (about 15 hours per week)



Edit video ads for Meta, TikTok, and Amazon Sponsored Brands.

Produce multiple hook and format variations of each concept for testing.



AI Workflow



Use AI tools throughout your workflow to speed up turnaround, such as AI masking and rotoscoping, auto captions, beat detection, and rough cut assembly, while keeping full creative control of the final edit.

Generate and edit video and visual assets with AI tools such as Seedance, Higgsfield, and Claude, and blend them with live footage.



Across All Work



Manage a steady weekly queue of requests from the Creative Director, Social Media Manager, and marketing managers.

Keep project files organized and deliver final exports in the correct specs for each platform.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



A portfolio of TikTok and Reels edits with creative transitions, masking, and visual tricks. Talking-head videos with subtitles will not be considered.

A precise sense of rhythm. Your edits land on the beat, not near it.

Strong typography and design sense, including font pairing, hierarchy, spacing, color contrast, and adapting text style to different brand identities.



Required



Working proficiency in both CapCut and DaVinci Resolve. Our team uses both for project handoffs.

Advanced motion graphics and effects skills in at least one professional tool, such as After Effects, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve (Fusion), or CapCut Pro.

Nice to Have

Ecommerce or consumer products experience.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application through OLJ with:



Links to 3 to 5 short-form videos you edited that show creative transitions, rotoscoping or masking tricks, or seamless loops. At least one must show beat-synced editing, and at least one must show custom on-screen typography. title: Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA
description:
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day (40 hours/week)

Position: Full-Time Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED.



Do NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before. I am specifically looking for someone who already understands Amazon product sourcing and can work independently.



You should already know how to analyze Amazon listings, research suppliers, verify websites, check sellers and competition, calculate profit, and determine whether a product is actually worth purchasing.



YOUR MAIN JOB



You must provide 5 VALID ASINs per day.



That equals 25 valid ASINs per week.



Finding 5 random products does NOT count. Products must meet ALL of my requirements and pass my review.



If some of your daily ASINs are rejected, you have until the end of the week/payday to replace them and reach the required 25 valid ASINs.



25 approved ASINs per week is the minimum requirement — not just 25 submissions.



BONUSES 💰



I reward VAs who consistently provide good leads and help me grow the business.



You can earn additional bonuses for:



Consistently finding valid ASINs: If your leads regularly pass my review and meet all requirements, you can receive performance bonuses.



More than 25 approved ASINs: If you finish your required 25 valid ASINs early and continue finding additional approved products, you can receive a bonus for exceeding your weekly target.



Finding profitable Amazon seller storefronts: If you discover a strong Online Arbitrage seller storefront that I can use for further product research, submit the storefront to me. If I review it and approve it as a good sourcing opportunity, you can receive a bonus.



High-quality sourcing: VAs who consistently find products that I actually purchase and successfully sell will have opportunities for additional bonuses and higher pay over time.



Quality still matters. Adding random ASINs just to go above 25 will NOT earn a bonus. Extra ASINs must meet the same requirements as your normal submissions and pass my review.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be a brand I am already approved/ungated to sell



Make at least $2 profit per unit



Have at least 50 estimated sales per month



NOT be a generic brand



Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales



Have enough room for me to enter the listing without immediately destroying the price



Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE



Be in stock and actually available to purchase



Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation



Include the correct source link



Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing



Not already have been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing an unrealistic quantity.



Example:



If a product only meets my requirements when buying 25 units, but the Amazon listing only sells around 50 units per month and has 20 competing sellers, I am obviously not going to purchase 25 units.



Use common sense.



Look at:



Monthly sales + number of sellers + competition + minimum purchase quantity.



The deal needs to make sense for MY business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before submitting it.



I recently had a VA provide a fake website that looked like a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website and the card information was compromised.



That cannot happen again.



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites



Scam websites



Copycat websites



Suspicious Shopify stores



Random websites with no established reputation



Sources you have not properly researched



A retailer/distributor different from the one you put in the spreadsheet



If you are unsure whether a source is legitimate, DO NOT SUBMIT IT. Ask me first.



QUALITY > RANDOM LEADS



I would rather receive 5 strong ASINs than 20 bad ones.



Do not fill the spreadsheet just to hit your number.



Repeatedly submitting products that clearly violate the requirements will result in termination.



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW



You should have previous experience with:



Amazon Seller Central



Amazon FBA



Online Arbitrage



Product sourcing



Keepa



SellerAmp SAS or similar tools



Buy Box analysis



Sales rank / estimated monthly sales



Amazon fees



Profit calculations



Seller/competition analysis



Variation matching



Source verification



Checking whether Amazon is on the listing



Identifying dangerous price drops or listings with too much competition



Amazon seller storefront sourcing / storefront stalking



You should NOT need me to teach you the basics of Amazon sourcing.



HOURS



Monday–Friday

8 hours per day

40 hours per week



This is a long-term position for the right person.



Starting pay is $2/hour, but strong performance can earn you bonuses and opportunities for increased pay.



The better the products you find and the more value you bring to the business, the more opportunity you have to earn.



HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with:



“I HAVE AMAZON SOURCING EXPERIENCE”



Then answer these questions:



How long have you been sourcing products for Amazon?



Have you done Online Arbitrage before?



What sourcing tools have you used?



Do you know how to use Keepa? Explain what you normally check on a Keepa chart.



Do you know how to use SellerAmp SAS?



How do you determine whether there are too many sellers on a listing?



How do you verify that a sourcing website is legitimate?



How do you determine how many units of a product you would recommend buying?



What is the difference between profit and ROI?



Have you used Amazon seller storefronts to find additional profitable products? Explain your process.



Send an example of an Amazon sourcing spreadsheet you have worked with before, with any confidential client information removed.



FINAL TEST: Include one example ASIN + source link that you believe would be worth researching for Online Arbitrage. Briefly explain why you chose it.

If you cannot answer these questions, please do not apply.

I am looking for someone who already knows what they are doing, pays attention to details, follows instructions, verifies their sources, and can consistently find products

title: Full-Time Performance Video Editor — DTC / E-Commerce Ads
description:
We are looking for a full-time Performance Video Editor to join our team and help us create direct-response ads for our DTC brands.



This is not a role for someone who only knows how to make videos look nice.



We are looking for someone who understands that the purpose of an ad is to grab attention, keep people watching, communicate the message clearly, and drive action.



If you enjoy studying ads, improving hooks, testing different angles, working with UGC, finding the right B-roll, and continuously making your edits better, this could be a good fit.



This is a long-term remote position with opportunities to grow as the company grows.



What You’ll Be Doing



Your main responsibility will be editing performance creatives for platforms such as Meta.



You will:



Edit short-form direct-response video ads



Edit UGC-style creatives



Edit longer-form ads and VSL-style creatives



Create strong hooks for the first few seconds



Improve pacing and retention throughout the video



Add captions, graphics, sound effects and pattern interrupts when needed



Find relevant B-roll and supporting footage



Work with raw UGC footage



Work with AI-generated images and video



Create different variations of winning ads



Recreate proven concepts in an original way for our brands



Follow scripts, briefs and reference ads closely



Make revisions based on feedback



Continuously improve creatives based on what is working



What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone with experience in:



DTC / e-commerce video ads



Direct-response advertising



UGC-style creatives



Meta ads



Short-form advertising



Video sales letters or longer-form ads



You should have a good understanding of:



Hooks



Pacing



Retention



Visual storytelling



B-roll selection



Pattern interrupts



Captions



Direct-response marketing



We especially want someone who tries to understand why an ad works, instead of simply following instructions without thinking.



Tools



You should be comfortable using video editing software such as:



CapCut



Adobe Premiere Pro



Or similar editing software



Experience with AI tools is also a big advantage, including tools such as:



ElevenLabs



HeyGen



Gemini



Nano Banana



AI image-generation tools



AI video-generation tools



You do not need to know every tool already.



However, you must be comfortable learning new tools quickly.



Who This Role Is NOT For



This position is probably not for you if most of your experience is editing:



Wedding videos



Gaming videos



Cinematic montages



Music videos



Generic social-media content



We are specifically looking for someone interested in becoming very good at performance creative and direct-response advertising.



What We Value



We value people who are:



Reliable



Detail-oriented



Fast learners



Good communicators



Able to follow instructions closely



Comfortable receiving feedback



Able to meet deadlines



Interested in marketing



Constantly trying to improve their work



Able to work independently without needing constant supervision



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term position, not someone looking for a temporary freelance project.



Compensation



Starting compensation:



$4–$6/hour depending on experience and skill level.



On top of your base pay, we also offer performance bonuses for winning creatives.



If a creative you edit becomes a winner and scales while maintaining our performance targets, you can earn:



$5,000 ad spend → $10 bonus



$10,000 ad spend → $20 bonus



$20,000 ad spend → $40 bonus



$30,000 ad spend → $50 bonus



$50,000 ad spend → $100 bonus



The bonus is based on the highest spend milestone reached by each creative.



For example:



If your creative reaches $20,000 in spend, the total bonus for that creative is $40.



The milestones are not added together.



We want our editors to benefit when their work performs well.



The better your creatives become and the more winning ads you help us produce, the more opportunities you will have to increase your compensation and responsibility within the company.



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position.



We are looking for someone who can work consistently each week and communicate reliably with the team.



We care more about reliability, output and quality than where you work from.



How To Apply



Please send us the following:



A link to your portfolio



Your 3 best DTC / e-commerce / direct-response ads



Please do not send us 30 random videos. We want to see the 3 ads that best represent your skills.



Tell us exactly what you did on those ads.



For example:



Editing



B-roll sourcing



UGC sourcing



AI generation



Voice-over



Captions



Motion graphics



Tell us which video editing and AI tools you currently use.



Tell us your current hourly rate.



Tell us how many hours per week you are available.



Tell us briefly about your previous experience working with DTC or e-commerce brands.



Start your application with the words:



PERFORMANCE EDITOR



If you do not include these words at the beginning of your application, your application will not be reviewed.



Hiring Process



If your portfolio looks like a good fit, we will invite you to complete a short editing trial.



The trial will be based on the type of creatives you would actually be producing for us.



We will evaluate:



Hook quality



Pacing



Clip selection



B-roll selection



Captions



Attention to detail



Ability to follow references



Overall direct-response instinct



We are not looking for perfection.



We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, good judgment, and the ability to improve quickly.



Long-Term Opportunity



We want to build a strong creative team, and we are looking for someone who can grow with us.



If you consistently produce strong work, learn quickly, and help us create winning ads, there will be opportunities for:



Higher compensation



More responsibility



Larger performance bonuses



A long-term position within the company



If this sounds like you, send us your application and your best work.



Remember to start your application with: PERFORMANCE EDITOR

title: Full Cycle Bookkeeper - Experienced 5 yr +
description:
Read this entire posting before applying. If you skip to the apply button, you will be rejected automatically.

I am done wasting time and money on VAs who overpromise and underdeliver. This posting is intentionally blunt so only qualified, serious candidates apply. If you do not meet ALL of the requirements below, do not apply — you will not be considered, and applications that ignore this will be deleted without a response.

Non-Negotiable Requirements — ALL of these are deal-breakers if not met:



1 -Speak and write English clearly. If you have a thick accent or are not fluent in written and spoken English, do not apply. This is an immediate disqualifier.

2 - Be an actual, hands-on expert in bookkeeping, payroll, and HR administration. I use QuickBooks Online, Cin7 Core for inventory/COGS, QBO for AP, and QBO for payroll. If you claim experience with these tools and then have to Google how to do basic tasks once hired, this is an immediate disqualifier. You will be tested before hire — see below.

3 - Explain things simply. I am not an accountant. If I ask you a question and you can't break it down in plain language I understand right away, do not apply. I need someone who translates the technical into the simple, not someone who talks over my head.

4 - Follow instructions exactly. I have had VAs guess at what I wanted, get "creative," do work I never asked for, and then expect to be paid for it. This happens ONCE and we're done. I am open to your suggestions on better ways to do things — but only with my approval before you act. Suggest, don't assume.

5 - Do not pad your hours. I know roughly how long tasks take, and I am generous about it. If I see 15-minute tasks billed as multi-hour tasks, my generosity disappears immediately and so does the job.

6 - Show up on time, every time. I understand life happens — tell me in advance and I will be understanding. Chronic lateness or last-minute excuses (storms, internet outages, etc., without advance notice) will end this immediately. One strike.

7 - We pay via Payoneer ONLY. No exceptions. If you don't have a Payoneer account or can't set one up, do not apply. This is nonnegotiable — no PayPal, no Wise, no bank transfer, no other method.

8 - We track time using Timeproof. Mandatory, no exceptions. If you are not willing to use Timeproof for every hour billed, do not apply. This is not up for discussion.

9 - Meetings are professional — no children visible or audible on camera. These are leadership meetings. My team does not bring kids into the office, and I expect the same from you. Have children asleep, at school, or with another caregiver during our scheduled meeting times. If a child is on camera or heard in the background, the meeting will end.

10 - If I call you during paid hours, you answer. Period. No exceptions, no "I saw it but was busy." If you're on the clock, you're reachable.



What You'll Be Doing:



Full-cycle bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online — transaction coding, reconciliations, AP/AR

Inventory and COGS tracking and reconciliation in Cin7 Core

Vendor bill capture, approval routing, and payment processing through or QBO

Payroll support and coordination through Paylocity

HR administrative support — onboarding documentation, recordkeeping, basic compliance tasks

Monthly financial reporting to ownership



Application Instructions — Read Carefully:



To prove you read this far, start your application with the word LEDGER in the subject line. Applications without it will not be opened.

Confirm in your application that you have a Payoneer account, are willing to use Timeproof for every hour worked, can keep meetings child-free, and will answer calls during paid hours. If you don't confirm all four, your application will be skipped.

Include your specific hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online and/or Cin7 Core — not "familiar with," actual experience.

Include your available start date and your hourly rate expectation.

Be prepared to complete a short paid skills test before any offer is made.



This is a long-term, part-time position for the right person, with room to grow. If you meet every requirement above and can prove it, I want to hear from you. If you don't, please save us both the time.

title: Social media Content Creator
description:
# Social Media Content Creator — Memes & Short-Form Video



**Remote | Part-Time/Freelance | Potential Permanent Position**



## About Confide



Confide is an early-stage startup building a new kind of platform centred around **real human connection, shared experiences and meaningful conversations**.



Sometimes people simply need an outlet — someone to talk to, someone who understands, or someone who has been through something similar and can offer advice or perspective.



Confide connects people looking for support and conversation with people who can draw on their own experiences to help. On the other side, creators can **share their experiences, build their personal brand, earn money and make a difference in someone's life.**



**Confide — where your story meets theirs.**



Our **pre-launch waitlist is now live**, and we're focused on building an engaged audience across the **US and UK**, with a particular focus on growing our American audience.



---



# The Role



We're looking for a creative **Social Media Content Creator** who understands memes, TikTok, Instagram, internet culture and short-form video.



You'll create finished content for Confide each week and send it via *
 to our Social Media Manager**, who will handle uploading, scheduling and managing our accounts.



This is not a traditional corporate content role. We want someone who understands **what people actually watch, share, send to friends and talk about online.**



The role will initially be freelance/part-time, but we're ultimately looking for the right person to potentially become a **permanent member of the Confide marketing team** as we grow.



---



# Weekly Content Required



You will create **9 finished pieces of content per week:**



### 3 Photo Memes

Funny, relatable, emotional or culturally relevant image-based content designed to generate shares, comments and engagement.



### 3 Video Memes

Short, entertaining videos using relevant memes, viral formats, trending sounds, POVs, pop culture and internet humour.



### 3 TikToks / Instagram Reels

Fully edited short-form videos including trends, storytelling, conversation starters, emotional content, questions/debates and occasional Confide promotional content.



That's approximately **36 finished pieces of content per month**, all delivered ready to post.



---



# What Our Content Should Feel Like



We **do not want corporate social-media content** or endless generic wellbeing graphics.



We want people to see Confide content and think:



**"This is literally me."**  

**"Why is this so accurate?"**  

**"I'm sending this to my friend."**  

**"I need to comment on this."**  

**"Wait... what is Confide?"**



Content can cover:



- Dating & relationships

- Breakups

- Friendship

- Family

- Work & careers

- Adulthood

- Loneliness

- Personal struggles

- Self-development

- Everyday situations

- Pop culture

- Current online conversations



Some posts should be **funny**, some **emotional**, some **thought-provoking**, and some designed to create debates in the comments.



Most importantly, the content should feel **native to TikTok and Instagram rather than like an advertisement.**



---



# Confide & Waitlist Content



Our waitlist is currently live, so while most content should be relatable and entertaining, some posts should naturally **allude to the Confide concept and create curiosity about what we're building.**



For example:



**"Sometimes you don't need everyone to understand. You just need someone who does."**



**"Your story could be exactly what somebody else needs to hear."**



**"What if the person who understood exactly what you're going through was one conversation away?"**



The objective is to turn:



**Great content → engagement → curiosity → profile visits → waitlist sign-ups.**



We don't want every post to advertise Confide. We want to **build a community first while naturally introducing the brand within it.**



---



# US Trends & Internet Culture



Understanding **American social-media culture is particularly important** for this position.



You should actively follow:



- US TikTok and Instagram trends

- Viral memes and sounds

- American pop culture

- Dating/relationship conversations

- Gen Z & Millennial humour

- Viral online conversations

- Emerging TikTok/Reels formats



You should also understand UK audiences.



We want someone proactive who sees a trend gaining traction and thinks:



**"I know how Confide could use this."**



—not someone who waits for us to provide every content idea.



---



# Your Responsibilities



You will:



- Create **9 finished pieces of content every week**

- Research current US and UK trends

- Generate original meme/content ideas

- Design photo memes

- Edit video memes

- Create TikToks and Reels

- Write strong hooks and on-screen text

- Adapt viral trends to the Confide brand

- Create content designed for shares, comments and engagement

- Occasionally create content promoting Confide and the waitlist

- Deliver all finished content to our Social Media Manager on time

- Respond to creative feedback and continuously improve the content



---



# Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



- Lives and breathes TikTok/Instagram culture

- Understands memes and internet humour

- Has strong knowledge of American social-media culture

- Understands emotional and relatable content

- Can create both image and video content

- Uses Canva, CapCut or similar tools confidently

- Has strong written English

- Can work independently

- Consistently brings fresh ideas

- Understands what makes content **shareable**

- Is reliable with deadlines

- Is interested in potentially growing with an early-stage startup



A good sense of humour and strong creative instincts are extremely important.



---



# Long-Term Opportunity



This will initially be a **freelance/part-time position**, but we're looking to build a long-term relationship rather than continuously hire different freelancers.



As Confide grows and launches, there will be an opportunity for the right person to potentially become a **permanent member of our marketing team**, take on greater responsibility and grow alongside the company.



---



# When Applying



Please send:



- Your portfolio

- Examples of photo memes you've created

- Examples of video memes/TikToks/Reels you've edited

- Social accounts you've created content for, if applicable

- Any experience creating content for US audiences

- The tools/software you use

- Your expected monthly rate for **36 finished pieces of content**



Please only apply if you're comfortable creating **all three formats: photo memes, video memes and TikTok/Reel content.**



We're looking for someone who understands **people, internet culture and social media** — and knows how to turn everyday experiences into content people want to watch, share and talk about.



**Confide.**

 you urgent requests on the same morning. How do you decide what to handle first?

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Real Estate and Architecture Reels (Per-Video, Long-Term)
description:
Job Type: Freelance / per-project, long-term ongoing work



Rate: $25–35 USD per finished reel (30–60 seconds), depending on length, experience, and edit complexity. Longer edits (1–3 minutes, documentary-style) are priced separately per project. Paid test edit for shortlisted applicants.



About us



MC Visuals is a San Diego-based marketing agency. We create content primarily architects, custom home builders, design-build firms, and real estate professionals. Our style is clean, cinematic, and story-driven, but it has to perform on social. We want edits that hold attention in the first three seconds and keep people watching, without losing the polished, high-end feel our clients expect.



The role: 



We’re looking for a video editor to turn our raw footage into short social media reels, mostly 30–60 seconds, for Instagram and other platforms. You’ll receive organized footage and a brief, and deliver a finished vertical edit ready to post. You’ll select the music for each edit unless we specify a track, so a strong ear for what fits the mood and performs on social is important.



We manage all projects in 
. Each edit will have its own task with the brief, footage links, deadline, and feedback, so you’ll always know what’s assigned, what’s due, and where things stand.



Typical work:



- Cutting 30–60 second vertical reels from cinematic footage (homes, construction, interiors, on-camera interviews)

- Color grading Sony S-Log3 footage to match our clean, cinematic look (reference examples provided)

- Music selection, pacing, and rhythm edits with strong hooks and retention-focused structure

- Motion graphics, animated text, and creative transitions when the edit calls for them (speed ramps, match cuts, masked transitions, kinetic captions)

- Clean, tasteful text overlays and captions

- Occasional 1–3 minute documentary-style brand films with interview audio and b-roll



Some edits will be minimal and cinematic. Others will be punchy and graphic-heavy. We need someone who can do both and knows when each is right.



We’re building toward a steady weekly workflow of several reels per week across multiple clients. We’ll start with a handful of edits to get aligned on style, then scale up quickly as we build trust.



You’re a fit if you have: 



- Experience editing real estate, architecture, or interior design video (strongly preferred)

- A portfolio of short-form vertical content (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts)

- Confident color grading skills, including experience with S-Log3 or similar log profiles

- Motion graphics and transition skills (After Effects a plus, but not required if you can do it in Premiere or Resolve)

- Access to a licensed music library (Epidemic Sound, Artlist, Musicbed, or similar) and good instincts for pairing music to footage

- A feel for what performs on Instagram and TikTok: hooks, retention, pacing, and trends, applied with taste

- An understanding of short documentary storytelling: how to build a hook, a story, and a payoff in under a minute

- Proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

- Comfort working in 
 (or willingness to learn; it’s simple)

- Reliable turnaround (within 1–3 days of receiving footage) and clear communication

- Comfort with English briefs and feedback



How to apply



Reply with:



Links to 2–3 short vertical edits you’re proud of. Ideally one cinematic/minimal and one with graphics and transitions, so we can see your range.

Which editing software you use

Which music library you have access to

Your typical turnaround time for a 45-second reel

Start your message with the word “CINEMATIC” so I know you read the full post



Shortlisted applicants (2–3 people) will receive a paid test edit using our real footage. Not everyone who applies will be tested. If it’s a good fit, this becomes ongoing work.

title: AI Talking Avatar Video Creator (Google Flow OMNI + CapCut) - 6 videos/day, long-term
description:
Watch this video first. This is the job:





Everything in it is AI. The man talking, his voice and every shot were made with OMNI in Google Flow, then cut together in CapCut. It got 12,000 likes and 2,300 comments because nobody scrolling past can tell it is AI.



I need someone who can make 6 videos like that every day.



WHAT MAKES THAT VIDEO WORK (and what you will be judged on)



- It looks like a normal person filmed it on their phone. Not cinematic, not polished, not "AI looking".

- It is the same man in every shot: same face, same hair, same clothes, same voice.

- His lips match every word. Nothing is cut off, nothing is doubled.

- What you see matches what he says. When he talks about ginger, there is ginger in his hand.

- He holds the real product on camera, label to the lens.

- The captions are clean and on time, and the music is quiet under his voice.



If you look at that video and think "I already make videos like this", keep reading. If you think "I could learn this", this job is not for you yet. I am not training anyone from zero.



YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE



1. Hands-on experience making talking clips with OMNI in Google Flow. Veo only, Kling, HeyGen or Higgsfield does not count.

2. At least 3 months of paid AI avatar video work for a client or brand.

3. At least 50 finished AI videos delivered (finished videos, not clips).

4. Solid CapCut: captions, keyframes, audio ducking, cutting to the beat of the voice.

5. Proof you have kept one character consistent across several videos.



A NORMAL DAY



The day before, I send you everything for each video: the script, a reference video, the character image and the start frames. You then:



1. Generate each line as its own Omni clip, from the start frame, one clip at a time.

2. Check every clip: face, voice, lip sync, every word said exactly as written. Redo any that fail.

3. Put the clips together in CapCut with captions and quiet background music, matching the reference video's pacing and shot order.

4. Export 9:16, 1080x1920 MP4 and upload each video as soon as it is done.



Videos are 1 to 2 minutes long. Week 1 is 4 to 5 videos a day while I check your workflow. After that it is 6.



OMNI SKILLS I EXPECT ON DAY ONE



- Frames mode (not Ingredients) so the clip starts on the exact image

- Short dialogue prompts: the action, the speaker, the delivery and the exact line, nothing else

- Choosing 4s, 6s or 8s to fit the line, so no words are cut off and there is no dead air

- Rewording a blocked prompt (filter / "reputational risk") without changing the spoken line

- x1 generations only, checked one at a time



CREDITS

Same hours and same days every week, Saturdays included. 3 strikes: missing a day without telling me first is a strike, and repeating a mistake after feedback is a strike. You need a computer that can export 6 videos a day and reliable internet.



HOW TO APPLY

No Omni videos, no reply. AI-written copy-paste applications that do not answer the questions get no reply either.



WHAT YOU GET

- My exact process and prompt library, plus Loom feedback

Ability to turn around fast, clean stringouts from raw footage.

title: Senior AI Ecommerce Designer, Amazon Listings and Ads
description:
ABOUT US



We sell pet products across several brands on Amazon, Chewy, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and through retail partners like Petco and Costco. We are looking for a Senior AI Ecommerce Designer to own the images that sell those products.



Your work d
 whether a shopper clicks and whether they buy. You will design Amazon and Chewy listing images, A+ Content, Brand Stories, storefronts, marketplace assets, Amazon ad creative, and landing pages. We measure your work by click-through rate and conversion rate, not by how it looks in a portfolio.



This role is for a designer who already uses AI every day. You will combine Photoshop and Illustrator with generative AI tools to concept, stage, and composite photorealistic product images in hours, not weeks. We need speed and volume, but neither is an excuse for generic work.



Pay: USD 1,500-2,000 per month

Schedule: US PST

Reports to: Creative Director, who sets weekly priorities. You will work closely with our Video Editor, Social Media Manager, and brand managers.



THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF



AI is not already part of your daily design workflow. This is a requirement.

Your work depends on templates, Canva layouts, or stock mockups.

You submit raw AI generations without retouching and compositing.

You need a week to deliver what a strong AI workflow can deliver in a day.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Marketplace Assets



Design Amazon main images that follow Amazon’s white background and product fill rules while standing out in search results.

Build full secondary image sets: benefit infographics, feature callouts, size charts, comparison charts, materials and ingredient visuals, lifestyle scenes, and in-use images.

Design Premium A+ and standard A+ modules, Brand Story carousels, and Brand Storefront pages.

Create Chewy listing images and rich content to Chewy’s specs.

Adapt assets for Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and retail partner requirements.

Design mobile-first. Every image must read clearly at thumbnail size on a phone.

Deliver multiple variations of main images and A+ Content for split testing, and use the results to shape the next round.

Audit and refresh underperforming listings using click-through and conversion data from the brand managers.



Amazon Ads and Landing Pages



Design Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display creative, Amazon Posts, and seasonal, deal, and promo graphics.

Deliver ad variations for testing and refresh creative as performance data comes in.

Design landing pages and Shopify product pages as full desktop and mobile mockups, with exported assets ready for our Shopify team to build.

Keep messaging and visuals consistent from ad to listing to landing page.



AI Workflow and Compositing



Use generative AI to explore several creative directions quickly before committing to one.

Generate photorealistic lifestyle scenes (homes, yards, apartments, balconies, pets in real settings) and composite our real products into them with correct lighting, shadows, perspective, scale, and color.

Replace, extend, and clean up backgrounds using Photoshop Generative Fill, Firefly, Flux, or similar tools.

Upscale and enhance images with Magnific or similar tools without adding artifacts.

Fix AI errors before anything ships: pet anatomy, paws, eyes, fur edges, warped geometry, garbled text, and incorrect product details.

Work from any source assets we have (studio photos, supplier images, 3D files, basic product shots) and flag when a reshoot is needed.

Build and maintain prompt libraries, style references, and scene templates to keep output consistent across brands.

Test new AI tools as they launch and recommend the ones that make the team faster or better.



Brand Consistency and Compliance



Keep each brand visually distinct while following its typography, color, and tone guidelines.

Keep products accurate in every image. AI must never change the size, color, texture, components, or packaging of what the customer receives.

Follow Amazon, Chewy, Walmart, and TikTok Shop image and content policies, including rules on claims, badges, and comparisons.

Use only product claims approved by the brand managers.

Use only AI tools and assets licensed for commercial use.

Keep organized, layered source files with clear naming and version control in our shared drive.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Design Fundamentals



4+ years of professional graphic design experience, with at least 2 years designing Amazon listing images and A+ Content.

Expert-level Photoshop and Illustrator, including advanced masking, color matching, compositing, and high-end retouching.

Strong typography. You pair fonts with intention, build clear hierarchy, and avoid generic or dated type.

Strong command of layout, grids, color, and visual hierarchy, including desktop and mobile landing pages.

Ability to turn a product benefit into a visual a shopper understands in 3 seconds, without a wall of text.

Working knowledge of what drives marketplace conversion: scannable benefits, objection handling, comparison framing, and image sequence.

Clear written English for on-image copy and daily work with a US-based team.



AI Prompting and Retouching



At least 1 year of daily, hands-on use of generative AI in professional design work.

Fluency with Midjourney, Photoshop Generative Fill and Firefly, Flux, Magnific, or similar tools.

Ability to control AI output: style and image references, inpainting and outpainting, seeds, and pose or composition control.

Ability to composite real products into AI scenes so the final image reads as a real photo.

A trained eye for AI artifacts and the retouching skill to fix them.

Ability to explain your workflow step by step and how much time AI saves you at each stage.



Nice to Have



Pet product or consumer packaged goods experience.

Experience with Amazon split testing (Manage Your Experiments), Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display creative, or reading click-through and conversion data.

3D rendering experience (Blender, KeyShot, or similar).

Basic motion or video skills to support our Video Editor.

Figma experience for templates and design systems.



PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS



Applications without a portfolio that includes ALL of the following will not be reviewed:



At least 2 complete Amazon listing image sets (main image plus full secondary carousel) that you designed.

At least 1 full A+ or Premium A+ Content project showing the complete module stack.

At least 1 landing page or ecommerce product page design, shown for desktop and mobile.

At least 3 before-and-after AI compositing examples. For each, show the original source photo, the raw AI generation, and your final image, with a short note on tools used and time spent.

Results where available, such as click-through or conversion lift or a split test outcome. If you are under NDA, explain what you changed and why.

Your role on each project: sole designer, lead, or part of a team.



Live Amazon or Chewy product links are welcome. Portfolios built mainly on templates, stock mockups, or unedited AI output will not move forward.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application through OLJ with:



A link to your portfolio (Google Drive, Behance, or personal site). Make sure the link is set to public.

A short note on which piece in your portfolio you are most proud of and why.

Start your message with the words “SCROLL STOPPER” so we know you read the full post.



Applications that skip any of these will not be reviewed.

title: YouTube Video Editor + 3D Animator Job Post
description:
YouTube Aviation Video Editor + 3D Animator — Long-Term



We are looking for a talented YouTube Video Editor with 3D animation experience to join our aviation channel long-term.



You will be responsible for editing one 10–12 minute aviation video per week, combining high-quality traditional YouTube editing with selective 3D animation and visualization.



IMPORTANT: This is NOT a full 3D animation role.



Most of each video should use a combination of:



* Relevant aviation footage

* Archive/historical footage when appropriate

* Images

* Maps

* Motion graphics

* Diagrams

* Text/labels

* Other visuals that accurately support the narration



3D should be used strategically when it improves the storytelling, explains something visually, or shows something that would be difficult to demonstrate with normal footage.



For example, 3D could be used to visualize:



* Aircraft movements or maneuvers

* Flight paths

* Aircraft components and systems

* Engineering or technical concepts

* Scale comparisons

* Interior/exterior aircraft structures

* Scenes where suitable real-world footage is unavailable



We want someone who understands when 3D adds value and when regular footage is the better choice.



⸻



JOB DETAILS



Niche: Aviation

Video Length: 10–12 minutes

Frequency: 1 video per week

Turnaround: Maximum 7 days per video

Position: Long-term, ideally 1+ year

Provided by Us: Completed script + voiceover



We are building this channel for the long term and would like to find an editor who can grow with us and help develop a recognizable visual style.



⸻



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT MOST



1. Visual Accuracy



The visuals should closely match what is being discussed.



If the script mentions a specific aircraft, aircraft variant, component, airline, airport, event, location, or historical time period, the footage should accurately represent it.



Do not use random aviation footage simply because it looks good.



Attention to detail is extremely important in this niche.



2. Viewer Retention & Storytelling



We want videos that feel polished and engaging without becoming overly edited.



Use pacing, visual changes, camera movement, graphics, music, sound design, and 3D sequences to keep the viewer interested throughout the video.



The editing should support the story rather than distract from it.



3. Strategic 3D Animation



You should be comfortable creating short, clean 3D sequences when needed.



You may use:



* Blender

* Cinema 4D

* Unreal Engine

* After Effects with 3D tools

* Or equivalent professional software



We are not expecting the entire 10–12 minute video to be animated in 3D.



4. Copyright-Safe Sourcing



You MUST understand how to avoid copyright issues when sourcing footage, images, music, and audio.



You should know how to properly use licensed, royalty-free, public-domain, Creative Commons, or otherwise legally usable assets when appropriate.



We do not want videos built around simply downloading copyrighted clips from other YouTube channels.



⸻



EDITING EXPECTATIONS



Each completed video should include:



* Accurate footage that matches the script

* Short 3D sequences where appropriate

* Clean pacing and storytelling

* Background music appropriate to the tone

* Sound effects when they improve the scene

* Maps, diagrams, or graphics when useful

* Consistent fonts, colors, and visual branding

* Clean transitions

* Subtle zooms and camera movements

* Labels/text when needed for explanation

* Professional audio balancing

* A finished video ready to upload to YouTube



We are not looking for excessive transitions, constant flashy effects, or over-editing.



The priority is:



Storytelling → Accuracy → Retention → Visual Quality



⸻



STYLE



We will provide reference channels/videos showing the overall quality and pacing we are looking for.



The goal is not to copy another channel exactly.



We want to build our own recognizable aviation editing style while taking inspiration from high-quality aviation documentary/explainer content.



⸻



REQUIREMENTS



You should have:



* Strong YouTube editing experience

* 3D animation experience

* Experience with Blender, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, or similar software

* Ability to create realistic and clean aviation-related 3D sequences

* Strong understanding of YouTube pacing and viewer retention

* Ability to source relevant, high-quality footage and images

* Strong attention to visual accuracy

* Good music and sound-design instincts

* Experience editing faceless YouTube content is preferred

* Strong English comprehension so visuals accurately match the script

* Reliable communication

* Ability to consistently meet weekly deadlines

* Willingness to make reasonable revisions when necessary



If you are a great traditional editor but cannot create 3D animation, this position is probably not the right fit.



⸻



WEEKLY WORKFLOW



Each week we will provide you with:



1. Script

2. Voiceover

3. Any additional direction or references



You will then:



1. Review the script and voiceover

2. Source accurate footage and visual assets

3. Plan where 3D animation would improve the video

4. Edit the complete 10–12 minute video

5. Add music, graphics, sound effects, and 3D sequences

6. Deliver the completed video within 7 days

7. Complete reasonable revisions if necessary



⸻



COMPENSATION



Please submit your price PER COMPLETED 10–12 MINUTE VIDEO.



Do not submit an hourly price unless you also clearly tell us what you would charge for one finished 10–12 minute video.



There is potential for consistent weekly work and a long-term relationship of 1+ year if the quality

title: Senior Meta Ads Specialist / Media Buyer
description:
Senior Meta Ads Specialist / Media Buyer



About the Role



We are looking for a Senior Meta Ads Specialist / Media Buyer who can take full ownership of our
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.



This is not a junior execution role. We are looking for someone who understands the strategy behind paid advertising, knows how to analyse campaign data, can identify what is working and what is not, and can confidently make decisions around budgets, audiences, creative testing, optimisation, and scaling.



You will be responsible for managing campaigns from strategy and setup through optimisation, reporting, and scaling, with a strong focus on generating quality leads or sales and achieving measurable business results.



We want someone who can work independently, take accountability for performance, and bring recommendations to the table rather than simply waiting for instructions.



What You'll Own

Meta Advertising Strategy

Develop and execute
 and Instagram advertising strategies based on our business and revenue goals.

Determine appropriate campaign objectives, audience strategies, budgets, offers, and testing approaches.

Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance and scale successful campaigns.



Campaign Management

Build, launch, manage, and optimise campaigns through Meta Ads Manager.

Manage campaigns, ad sets, audiences, placements, bidding, budgets, and creative variations.

Manage prospecting, retargeting, custom audiences, lookalike audiences, and other relevant targeting strategies.

Monitor campaign performance and make data-driven optimisation decisions.



Testing & Optimisation

Test different audiences, ad creatives, ad copy, offers, landing pages, and campaign structures.

Identify winning combinations and allocate budget accordingly.

Optimise campaigns based on CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, lead quality, and other relevant KPIs.



Tracking & Analytics

Set up, monitor, troubleshoot, and validate:

Meta Pixel

Conversions API (CAPI)

Conversion events

UTM/campaign tracking

Other relevant conversion tracking systems

Ensure campaign data is accurate and reliable.

Work with sales teams to understand whether generated leads are actually converting into qualified opportunities and customers.



Reporting

Provide clear weekly and monthly performance reports.

Explain what happened, why performance changed, what is working, what is not working, and what should be tested next.

Present actionable recommendations based on campaign data.



Collaboration

Work closely with designers, copywriters, sales teams, and other stakeholders to improve campaign performance.

Provide clear creative briefs and feedback based on advertising data.

Communicate campaign priorities, challenges, and opportunities proactively.



What We're Looking For



You should have:



At least 5 years of hands-on Meta Ads experience.

Proven experience managing
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

Strong practical knowledge of media buying, audience targeting, campaign structure, bidding, and optimisation.

Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets.

A proven track record of generating leads, sales, or measurable business results.

Experience scaling campaigns while maintaining acceptable CPL, CPA, ROAS, or other agreed KPIs.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Experience with conversion tracking and attribution.

The ability to work independently and take ownership of campaign performance.

Strong communication and reporting skills.



We Particularly Value Candidates Who Have:

Managed advertising for Australian businesses.

Experience with B2B, service-based businesses, lead generation, or high-ticket offers.

Experience working with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or other CRM platforms.

Experience connecting advertising performance with actual sales outcomes.

Meta advertising certifications.

Experience managing multiple campaigns or accounts simultaneously.



What Success Looks Like



Your success in this role will be measured by your ability to generate quality business results, not simply by launching campaigns.



Key performance indicators may include:



Quality and volume of leads or sales generated

Cost per qualified lead

Cost per acquisition

Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), where applicable

Conversion rates

Lead-to-customer performance

Ability to identify and scale winning campaigns

Ability to control and optimise advertising spend

Accuracy of tracking and attribution

Quality and usefulness of reporting

Speed and effectiveness of optimisation decisions



What We Expect From Our Senior Media Buyer



We are looking for someone who will think like an owner.



If a campaign is underperforming, we expect you to investigate why and recommend a solution.



If a campaign is performing well, we expect you to identify opportunities to scale it.



You should be comfortable saying:



“Here is what the data is telling us, here is the problem, and here is what I recommend we do next.”



You should not need to be micromanaged to monitor campaigns, identify issues, or make optimisation recommendations.



How to Apply



To be considered for this position, please complete both required forms:



1. Personality Assessment





2. Candidate Application Form





Both forms must be completed. After submitting both, please state in your application:



“I have completed both forms.”



Only candidates who complete both forms will proceed to the next stage of the hiring process.



Campaign Experience



Please provide 2–3 campaign examples showing:



Your role and responsibilities

Campaign objective

Industry/business type

Approximate advertising budget

Campaign duration

Target audience

Leads or sales generated

CPL / CPA / ROAS, if applicable

Key challenges

What you personally did to improve performance

Final results



Please remove or anonymise any confidential client information.

- Oversee our support team and the systems handling our email and inbox flow — you're the quality control that makes sure nothing slips

Required (you will not be considered without these)

- Minimum 2 years of property management and leasing support (long-term, short-term, or mid-term rentals all qualify)

- Excellent spoken English and a confident, warm phone presence — this role lives on the phone

- Strong written English for email and CRM notes

- Genuinely strong attention to detail and follow-through (we test this)

- Comfortable coordinating people, vendors, and systems — and holding others accountable

- Reliable daily availability on U.S. Central hours + consistent end-of-day reporting



Nice to have (not required — we train)

- Leasing/screening software (TurboTenant, AppFolio, Buildium) or GoHighLevel

- Team lead, operations coordinator, or executive-assistant background



What success looks like at 90 days

Every applicant answered fast and professionally. Units leasing faster with a clean CRM. Vendors coordinated, the owner's inbox and phone handled, the team running smoothly, nothing slipping.



How to apply

1. Put the word "Blueprint" at the top of your message so we know you read this fully.

2. Attach your resume — it must clearly show your 2+ years of property management/leasing support and the U.S. client(s) you did it for.

3. Record a short (60-90 sec) voice or video recording answering: Tell us about your property management and leasing experience with U.S. clients, and why you're a fit for a phone-forward leasing role.

4. Answer briefly in writing:

 - A renter calls about a unit while you have five other applications waiting and a vendor issue to coordinate — walk us through your day.

 - Your current availability in U.S. Central Time, and your phone setup (quiet space, headset, reliable internet).



Applications missing the keyword, the recording, the written answers, or the 2-year U.S. property-management requirement won't be reviewed.
