title: Short-Form Content Clipper / Social Media Growth Editor
description:
Remote | Performance-Based | 30-Day Pilot With Long-Term Opportunity



I’m looking for **1–2 creative short-form content clippers** who understand what makes people stop scrolling, keep watching, share, comment, subscribe, and come back for more.



This is **not a traditional video editing position.**



I am a creator, entrepreneur, and strategic leader creating content around personal growth, relationships, motherhood, business, confidence, culture, life experiences, and thought-provoking conversations.



Each week, I will provide original long-form videos, conversations, reflections, and other raw content.



Your job is to find the strongest moments inside that content, turn them into compelling short-form videos, package them for discovery, and publish them on an **assigned company-owned YouTube channel.**



The initial pilot will run for **30 days**, with the opportunity to continue and expand based on performance.



## THE ROLE



You will be assigned a YouTube channel that we own and control.



You will be responsible for helping grow that channel using our original content.



You will **not** be posting to our primary personal social media accounts.



Instead, think of your assigned channel as a discovery channel where you can experiment with content, identify what resonates with audiences, and build an audience around the ideas and conversations within the source material.



During the initial pilot, **YouTube Shorts will be our primary focus.**



There may also be opportunities to distribute content on TikTok, and strong performers may eventually operate across both YouTube and TikTok.







## WHAT YOU’LL DO



Each week, you will receive original source content from me.



You will:



- Review the source material

- Identify the strongest moments without being told exactly what to clip

- Turn those moments into compelling YouTube Shorts

- Determine where each clip should begin and end

- Develop strong hooks and opening frames

- Edit for retention and natural pacing

- Add clean, engaging subtitles

- Write strong YouTube titles and descriptions

- Create covers when appropriate

- Publish consistently to your assigned channel

- Test different hooks, lengths, topics, and editing approaches

- Optimize future content based on actual performance

- Appropriately credit and direct viewers toward our official social media ecosystem

- Monitor views, retention, subscribers, engagement, and other relevant analytics

- Report performance so we can identify what is working



You will have meaningful creative freedom.



I do **not** want someone who needs me to tell them:



*"Clip 2:13–2:47."*



I want someone who can watch a 10-minute conversation and recognize:



**“That is the moment people are going to stop for.”**



## THIS IS A GROWTH ROLE, NOT JUST AN EDITING ROLE



My primary content team already creates intentional content for my official brand channels.



This role serves a different purpose.



Your job is to help me:



**Test ideas.**

**Discover what resonates.**

**Build additional distribution.**

**Grow an audience.**

**Learn from the data.**



I want someone who thinks beyond:



**“Did I edit the video?”**



I want you thinking:



**Why did this Short get 500 views while another received 50,000?**



**Why did people keep watching one video but swipe away from another?**



**Which opening sentences consistently stop people?**



**Which topics generate comments, shares, and subscribers?**



**What did the audience respond to that we should test again?**



**What should I change on the next video based on what the data is telling me?**



If those questions interest you, you may be a strong fit.







## COMPENSATION



IMPORTANT: The salary displayed on this job posting is not representative of guaranteed or expected compensation. OnlineJobs.ph requires a salary figure to publish the listing. This is a performance-based assignment, so actual compensation may be higher or lower than the amount shown depending on the organic performance of your content. The complete compensation structure will be disclosed and agreed upon before you accept the assignment.



This is primarily a **performance-based opportunity.**



Your compensation will be tied to the organic performance of the content you create and distribute.



The initial compensation structure will use a CPM-style model based on qualified organic views after an established minimum performance threshold.



There may also be additional incentives for exceptional performance, audience growth, and breakout content.



Exact compensation rates, eligible views, performance thresholds, measurement periods, payment caps, and reporting requirements will be provided and agreed upon **before the pilot begins.**



The goal is simple:



**The better you become at identifying, packaging, and distributing content people actually want to watch, the greater your earning potential can become.**



Purchased views, subscribers, followers, engagement, bots, engagement groups, paid traffic, or any other artificial method of increasing performance are strictly prohibited.



Only legitimate organic performance will qualify for compensation.



## WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR



You may be a great fit if:



- You genuinely understand YouTube Shorts

- You understand hooks and audience retention

- You can recognize a powerful moment without someone pointing it out

- You understand storytelling and human psychology

- You have excellent English comprehension

- You understand the difference between an interesting statement and a compelling piece of content

- You understand how titles, opening frames, pacing, captions, and packaging affect distribution

- You regularly consume short-form content and understand current editing and storytelling styles

- You are comfortable experimenting

- You pay attention to analytics

- You learn from underperforming content instead of simply posting more of it

- You can work independently

- You are reliable and communicative

- You are comfortable working in a performance-based environment



Experience with TikTok is a plus because the program may eventually expand to both platforms.



You do **not** need to make every video look highly produced.



Sometimes the strongest content is simply:



**A powerful idea + the right opening + clean editing + good packaging.**



Good judgment matters more to me than fancy editing.







## THE CHANNEL



The YouTube channel you work on will be **owned and controlled by me/my company.**



You will receive the appropriate access needed to operate the channel during your assignment.



The channel, audience, content library, subscribers, analytics, and other channel assets remain company property.



If our working relationship ends, your access to the channel will end, but the channel and its content will remain intact.



You will also receive limited permission to use my original footage and likeness solely for work performed as part of this program.







## IMPORTANT CONTENT & BRAND RULES



You may not:



- Change the meaning of something I said

- Create fake quotes

- Intentionally remove context in a way that misrepresents my position

- Use AI to make me appear to say or do something I did not say or do

- Purchase or artificially generate views, subscribers, followers, or engagement

- Upload my source footage to unauthorized accounts

- Use my likeness, voice, or content for unrelated purposes

- Sell, license, distribute, or repurpose my source material outside of this project

- Represent yourself as me

- Represent an assigned clipping channel as my primary personal account



Creative packaging is encouraged.



Misrepresentation is not.







## HOW TO APPLY



Please do **not** send me a long generic cover letter.



I care much more about whether you understand content.



Please send:



1. Your name and location.



2. Tell me about your experience with **YouTube Shorts**.



3. If you also have experience growing TikTok accounts, tell me about that as well.



4. Links to 2–3 short-form videos you personally edited, if available.



5. Links to any YouTube channels, TikTok accounts, or social accounts you have helped grow, if available. Please explain what your role was.



6. What editing software do you use?



7. Briefly answer:



**What makes someone stop scrolling and watch a person they have never seen before?**



8. Answer this scenario:



**You post 10 Shorts. One receives 100,000 views. The other nine each receive fewer than 2,000 views. Before creating the next 10 videos, what would you analyze and what would you do differently?**



9. Tell me about one short-form video you have seen recently that you thought was exceptionally well packaged. What made it work?



10. Tell me why a **performance-based clipping role** interests you.



And finally:



**Begin your application with the words “I found the moment.”**



Applications that do not begin with those words may not be reviewed.







## PAID TEST



Final candidates may receive the **same piece of raw content** and be asked to identify and edit the moments they believe have the strongest potential.



The test will be paid.



I am intentionally **not going to tell you which moments to choose.**



I want to see:



**What you notice.**

**What you choose.**

**Where you start the video.**

**How you package it.**

**Why you believe someone will watch it.**



Your editorial judgment matters just as much as your technical editing ability.



## 30-DAY PILOT & LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



I am intentionally starting small with only **1–2 clippers.**



The initial engagement will be a 30-day pilot.



During those 30 days, I will evaluate more than total views.



I will be looking at:



- Content quality

- Consistency

- Audience retention

- Subscriber growth

- Engagement

- Ability to identify strong moments

- Ability to learn from analytics

- Communication

- Reliability

- Overall channel growth



If the model works, I intend to expand it.



Strong performers may have opportunities to continue managing their channel, expand into TikTok, operate additional channels, earn increased performance compensation, and take on larger responsibilities as the clipping program grows.



I am looking for people who want to **build something**, not simply complete editing assignments.



If you understand storytelling, audience psychology, YouTube Shorts, and why people share ideas online, I would love to see what you can do.

You’ll work closely with me and our video editors to develop creative ideas and grow with the business long-term.

---

- Performance bonuses and future growth opportunities are available.

- Daytime Philippines working hours.

TO APPLY

title: Executive & Marketing Operations Assistant E-commerce
description:
Remote | Full-time |Australian Eastern Time required



About us



FDYS is a media-led outdoor, fishing and lifestyle business operating across multiple ecommerce verticals.



Across our brands, our YouTube channels have more than 3.7 million subscribers. Content is at the centre of what we do: it grows the audience, builds community and drives e-commerce demand.



We are looking for a highly organised, proactive operator to help our founders, marketing lead and wider team keep everything moving across content, social media, e-commerce, customer support, reporting and day-to-day business operations.



This is not a basic task-only virtual assistant role. We want someone who can follow systems, spot what needs attention, communicate early and take responsibility for closing the loop.



This is a broad coordinator role across executive support, content operations, e-commerce, customer support, reporting and team follow-through. Content planning is a high-priority part of the role, but this is not a single-creator personal-content-manager position.



The opportunity



You will work across several connected parts of the business. One important responsibility is helping turn current trends, business activity, fishing/outdoor life and approved campaigns into ready-to-film content plans so the team is not starting from a blank page each day.



You will also keep projects moving, follow up people and deadlines, support the customer-service workflow, prepare reports and make sure the founders and marketing lead have a clean view of what needs attention.



You will begin as a hands-on coordinator and can grow into broader Growth Operations, E-commerce Operations or Executive Operations responsibility as you prove your capability.



What you will do



Executive and team operations



•

Keep the master task tracker, content tracker and follow-up list accurate, with clear owners, deadlines, status and next actions.



•

Follow up editors, agencies, suppliers, collaborators and team members on deadlines and approvals.



•

Coordinate meetings, reminders, call notes and action items.



•

Keep Google Drive folders, files, links and documentation organised.



•

Help with appointments, research, bookings, vehicle servicing, property maintenance coordination and general founder administration.



•

Track outstanding actions and flag clashes, delays and blockers early with a suggested next step.



Customer support and e-commerce coordination



•

Support our approved customer-support workflow as the human quality-control layer behind our AI tools.



•

Review customer context, verified order/tracking information and drafted replies before they are approved and sent.



•

Handle straightforward enquiries about verified order status, tracking, sizing, product links and general FAQs using approved guidance.



•

Keep the support queue organised so cases are assigned, followed up and closed properly.



•

Pull Shopify reports and help track sales, orders, AOV, conversion, top products, stock flags and product performance.



•

Log incoming supplier and business invoices into the approved register, flag duplicates/discrepancies and follow up on items awaiting approval.



Marketing operations and reporting



•

Schedule approved posts and upload approved assets across the agreed social platforms.



•

QA test
 campaigns before sending: check links, product details, discount details, spelling and basic layout.



•

Pull marketing and e-commerce reporting from approved dashboards.



•

Explain basic movements in sales, conversion rate, AOV, traffic, ad spend, ROAS, CPA/CAC,
 revenue and top-product performance in plain English.



•

Prepare a short daily business brief covering sales/store, marketing, content due, customer issues, stock concerns, overdue tasks and decisions required from the founders.



•

Check AI-generated summaries against the source information and clearly separate confirmed facts from items still awaiting verification.



Data, stocktake and systems coordination



•

Help create one clear operating picture across Shopify, marketing dashboards, warehouse/stocktake records, customer support, team trackers and approved AI-agent outputs.



•

Compile daily and weekly reporting from approved sources, clearly labelling the reporting period and source for every important number.



•

Reconcile expected comparisons, such as Shopify inventory against warehouse stocktakes, marketing-platform spend against campaign reports, and AI summaries against the underlying source data.



•

Maintain a simple Data Exceptions Log for any mismatch: what the two sources say, the period, the variance, the owner, the next action and the date it was raised.



•

Request missing inputs, follow up on gaps and escalate material stock, marketing, customer-support or financial-data discrepancies quickly.



•

Maintain consistent definitions for key metrics such as gross sales, net sales, units sold, available stock, on-hand stock, ad spend, ROAS, CAC and profit.



•

Use approved systems only and handle customer/business data carefully. Do not place confidential data into personal tools or unapproved AI platforms.





Content, social media and trend research



•

Build and maintain a rolling two-week content calendar across our brands.



•

Prepare weekly content packs: ready-to-film post ideas with an exact hook, first visual, short script cue, B-roll needed, simple shot list, platform, CTA and any product/content link.



•

Prepare daily natural Story prompts so the relevant team member has a simple plan for what to show, say or ask their audience.



•

Research current short-form video formats and viral hooks across fishing, boating, outdoor, lifestyle and adjacent creator niches.



•

Turn approved trends into original concepts. You will adapt the format or hook—not copy another creator’s exact footage, script or creative work.



•

Maintain a Hook Bank showing the source, why it works, the Field Days version, footage needed, performance result and whether it should be reused.



•

Create clear briefs for editors, captions/CTA options and scheduling details. Follow approved content through to posting.



•

Help with routine comments and DMs using approved brand guidance; escalate sensitive issues immediately.



•

Review content performance weekly and use the learnings to improve the next plan.





What we are looking for



•

2+ years of experience as an executive assistant, operations coordinator, e-commerce coordinator, marketing coordinator.



•

Excellent written English and the ability to write clear, natural customer-facing messages.



•

Strong organisation and follow-through across multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders.



•

A genuine instinct for short-form content: you can identify why a hook works and turn it into a clear, practical filming plan.



•

Comfortable with Shopify, klaviyo, meta ads, google analytics, reporting, social media tools, Google Drive, Slack, spreadsheets, calendars and task trackers.



Comfortable with ai including claude, ai agents, manus etc



•

Practical understanding of e-commerce and performance-marketing metrics: sales, conversion rate, AOV, CTR, CPM, CPA/CAC and ROAS.



•

Comfortable in Google Sheets or Excel, including filters, formulas, pivots and basic reconciliation checks.



•

You understand that revenue and ROAS alone do not equal profit.



•

Confident using AI tools to draft and organise work, while checking outputs rather than trusting them blindly.



•

Strong judgement, confidentiality and attention to detail.



•

Proactive communication: when you find a problem, you flag it early, give context and recommend a next step.



Nice to have



•

Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, Klaviyo/email QA, Later, Buffer, Meta Business Suite or similar platform experience.



•

Experience working with founder-led e-commerce, media or creator businesses.



•

Basic Canva or Figma skills.



•

Experience documenting SOPs, building dashboards or improving workflows.



Access and decision-making boundaries



You will have access only to the tools and information needed to do your role well. Access is staged as trust and capability develop.



You can coordinate, draft, check, report, organise, escalate and follow up..



How we work



We operate from one shared task system. Every meaningful request must have a clear owner, deadline, status and next action. You will not be expected to silently juggle conflicting private requests; you should raise priority clashes early and recommend what needs to move.



We value people who close the loop. Do not simply report that something is pending follow it through, update the relevant people and make sure there is a clear next step or a documented closure.



Application process

To apply, please send the following:

1. A short introduction video



Record a short video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be a great fit for this role. 



Please upload it to Google Drive, Loom, or another platform where we can easily watch it, then include the link in your application.



Important: The video is a required part of the application. This role requires strong attention to detail, clear communication and the ability to follow instructions. Applications without a video will not be considered.



2. Your CV and relevant examples



Please include your CV, along with any relevant examples of work you have completed such as dashboards, content calendars, reporting, social-media plans, task systems, operational trackers or similar work.



Shortlisted candidates will then complete a paid practical assessment.
